cn.trackName: Sorapuff: 飞行恐惧安心助手
cn.description:
Sorapuff 是一位温柔的飞行伙伴，专为怕坐飞机的你而设计。登机前，它会告诉你航线上哪里可能出现颠簸；在空中，它会离线为你解释每一下颠簸，Sora 一直陪在你身边。

起飞之前
• 航线颠簸预报，由你的 iPhone 根据免费的公开气象数据（NOAA）计算
• 一段一段告诉你是平稳、轻微还是中度颠簸，用大白话说清楚：“前两个小时可能很平稳”
• 沿途的雷暴警告（SIGMET）和最新飞行员报告
• 航线地图，标出每段颠簸区域、雷暴和飞行员报告（Pro）
• 提醒：预报准备好时、开启飞行模式前记得保存，以及登机时

在空中，飞行模式下也能用
• 大大的航班追踪：你在哪里、还要飞多久、接下来会发生什么
• 让人安心的颠簸计，测量每一下颠簸，告诉你它其实有多小。机翼的设计承受能力是 2.5 g
• Sora 为每个阶段准备的小贴士，从滑行到降落
• 颠簸路段前 10 分钟提前告诉你，不让你措手不及

当你觉得有点撑不住时
• 只需轻点一下：和 Sora 一起呼吸，用轻柔缓慢的触感感受每一次呼吸，一步一步让自己平静下来
• 可选的舒缓音乐，在你的 iPhone 上实时生成
• 可从主屏幕、Siri、快捷指令、操作按钮和控制中心打开

落地之后
• 你的颠簸报告：用文字记录每一下颠簸，还有一张漂亮的卡片可以分享（“我飞到啦！”）
• 每个勇敢的时刻都能收集天空卡片，还能给 Sora 换上新装扮

飞行的人帮助飞行的人
• 落地之后，轻点一下就能发送这次航班的颠簸数据：匿名，只有两个机场代码、起飞时间和颠簸
• 每一次分享的航班，都会把预报和真实颠簸对照一遍，帮助它为下一位紧张的乘客变得更好

私密地找出你的航班
• 粘贴预订邮件、打开 PDF 或扫描登机牌
• 或者让 Sorapuff 在你的日历中查找预订；如果你愿意，也可以在你的 iPhone 上以只读方式搜索你的邮件

从设计上保护隐私
• 无需账户，没有广告，没有追踪，没有分析
• 你的航班只保存在你的 iPhone 上

一次买断
Sorapuff 可免费下载，包含颠簸计、航班追踪、安心陪伴、呼吸练习和你的第一次航线预报。Sorapuff Pro 只需购买一次，无需订阅：无限次预报（最多提前 3 天）、航线地图、全部天空卡片和装扮、所有音乐风格、小组件和实时活动。支持家人共享。

Sorapuff 提供信息与放松工具，不构成医疗建议：请始终听从机组人员的指示。

cn.trackName: Comic Weather: 搞笑天气预报
cn.description:
Comic Weather 是一款 iPhone 天气 App，把你的天气预报变成一页漫画。你头顶的天空被画成开篇第一格，解说员在黄色解说框里总结当天天气，接下来的每个小时和每一天则在下方的画格中依次展开。

墨线之下，是来自 Apple Weather 的真实天气预报：当前天气、未来一小时的降雨、未来 24 小时、未来 10 天，以及官方恶劣天气预警。

【四款漫画主题】
• 四色印刷：报摊漫画的经典模样。本戴网点、鲜明的原色和浓重的黑墨。
• 泡泡糖花开：粉彩流行风。泡泡糖粉、薄荷绿与丁香紫，还有花朵与闪光。
• 巨城漫画：浓密的漫画墨线，勾勒高耸入云的城市、灯火映照的街巷和风云变幻的天空。
• 午夜之城：哥特黑色风格。近乎全黑的纸页、琥珀色灯光、雨中尖塔。
主题会重新印制整个 App：画格、字体、天气图标、每一个小组件，还有 App 图标。

【192 幅彩绘场景】
十二种天气，每种都分别画有黎明、白天、黄昏和夜晚四个版本，四款主题各有一套：从晴空和雾，到雪、风暴和酷热。每个场景都会动起来：暴雨倾泻，浓雾涌来，灯火闪烁，闪电劈落。开启“减弱动态效果”或“低电量模式”后，场景会保持静止。

【降雨，分秒必争】
在 Apple Weather 提供逐分钟数据的地区，会有一个画格绘出未来一小时的降雨图：“12分钟后开始下雨”。轻点“在锁定屏幕上显示”，倒计时就会移到锁定屏幕和灵动岛上；也可以让它为你的主要地点自动开始。

【日落预报】
是满天火烧云，还是哑火一场？一个新画格为下一场日落评级，从“哑火”到“史诗级”，附上满分 100 分的评分、日落时间，以及黄金时刻开始和蓝调时刻结束的时间。它读取 Apple Weather 的低云、中云和高云，以及降雨、湿度和能见度，并告诉你原因：“高云会染上霞光。”“雨后初晴，空气如洗。”这是预报，不是承诺。

【每款主题，都有自己的声音】
每款主题都配有专属解说员，为画面配文，也为通知执笔。随时可以更换：
• 四色印刷 × 戏精：“大雾将整座城市一口吞下。前行务必小心。”
• 泡泡糖花开 × 元气：“起雾啦！整座城市在玩捉迷藏！”
• 巨城漫画 × 热血：“有雾。地图还没加载出来。”
• 午夜之城 × 冷面：“雾。世界已切换成标清画质。”

【一格一格看预报】
• 当前天气、体感温度，以及今天的最高和最低气温
• 此时此刻：风与阵风、湿度、紫外线、气压、能见度、日出和日落
• 未来 24 小时逐小时预报，附降水概率
• 10 日天气预报。轻点任意一天，即可查看降水量、风、紫外线指数、日出、日落和月相
• 来自官方机构的恶劣天气预警（如有）
• 保存多个地点，轻扫即可切换，可按位置添加，也可按城市名称添加
• 单位随你选：°C 或 °F；风速可选公里/时、英里/小时、米/秒、节或蒲福风级；降水量、气压和距离单位也可自选

【只在预报需要时才发通知】
• 在你选定的时间送上早间播报
• 降雨开始前和停止前发出降雨提醒
• 傍晚的计划建议：“明天晴天——做个计划吧”
• 恶劣天气预警，以及明天有高温或霜冻时的提前提醒
• 今晚日落有望“绚烂”或“史诗级”时，提前约一小时发出日落提醒
这些通知由你的 iPhone 根据已下载的预报自行生成。每种通知都可以单独开启或关闭。

【小组件、Siri 和控制中心】
• 整页漫画（大）：画格、接下来几小时和未来几天
• 连环漫画（中）和单格漫画（小）
• 用于锁定屏幕的天气图标
• 无论主屏幕设为着色还是透明风格，每个小组件都显示得恰到好处
• 对 Siri 说“Comic Weather，会下雨吗？”或“Comic Weather 天气预报”，也可以在快捷指令中使用
• 此刻天气：控制中心里的按钮，显示你所选任意地点的气温

【分享画格】
轻点一下，就能把今天的画格印成图片，发到“信息”或你的动态里。

【说你的语言】
每个界面、每句解说、每条通知和每个小组件都支持 26 种语言，从 Español、Deutsch 到 हिन्दी、العربية、简体中文和 Bahasa Melayu。

【隐私，从设计开始】
无需账户。没有广告。没有跟踪。没有分析。Comic Weather 只请求你的大致位置，将其四舍五入到约 100 米，再直接发送给天气服务。Comic Weather 没有自己的服务器。

【为旁白和大字体而设计】
旁白会朗读每一格画面，“简明朗读”可为你读出不带笑话的天气预报。文字最大可放大到辅助功能的最大字号。

【离线也能看】
没有信号？你上一次的天气预报会留在页面上，并标明是多久以前的。

【免费试用，Full 版一次买断】
四色印刷主题、10 日天气预报、降雨提醒和一个小号小组件均可免费使用。全部功能可免费试用 7 天，之后只需一次性解锁 Comic Weather Full（完整版）：所有主题和解说员、日落预报、全部小组件以及降雨倒计时。无订阅，无广告。已经买过？一切照旧归你所有。

天气数据来自 Apple Weather，并以 MET Norway（挪威气象研究所）作为备用来源。Apple Weather 是 Apple Inc. 的商标。

问题或建议：support@comicweather.app

advisories: 无限制网页访问
cn.releaseNotes:
ScreenCommand 3.0 为电视带来了右键菜单和手形光标、浏览历史记录，点按也会落在你瞄准的位置。在 iOS 27 上，键盘恢复正常。

电视上的新功能
• 右键点按（在触控板上双指轻点，或鼠标右键）会在电视上打开菜单：在新标签页中打开链接、拷贝链接或图像地址、拷贝所选文本、粘贴、返回、前进和刷新。
• 光标移到链接和按钮上时会变成手形（设置 › 触控板与光标 › 手形光标）。电视地址栏有全屏按钮，可在 设置 › 外接显示器 › 电视上的全屏按钮 中关闭。
• 你在 iPad 或 iPhone 上编辑的地址会像在文本框中一样显示在电视上：所选内容高亮显示，或者显示闪烁的光标。在电视上用鼠标点按可放置光标，拖移可选择，连按两下可选择一个词。
• 电视地址栏中的盾牌：网页无法正常运行时，可为屏幕上的网站或所有网站关闭弹出式窗口拦截，打开或关闭“拦截所有弹出式窗口”，并查看该网页上拦截了多少个弹出式窗口。iPad 或 iPhone 地址栏中的盾牌也有相同的开关。
• 电视地址栏中的 − 和 + 会显示网页的缩放比例，轻点“重置”即可恢复到 100%。编辑网址时，用箭头打开它；在登录页面上，用钥匙打开你存储的密码。

iPad 和 iPhone 上的新功能
• 历史记录：在 iPad 或 iPhone 上轻点“收藏”旁边的时钟，即可按日期查看并搜索你在电视上打开的网页；电视上星形图标旁边的时钟会列出最新的网页。可以再次打开、轻扫删除，或清除过去 1 小时、过去 24 小时、过去 7 天、过去 4 周或全部的记录。
• 设置 › 隐私：清除历史记录，或者清除 Cookie 和网站数据，从而退出各网站的登录，重新开始。
• 设置 › 收藏 › 从 Safari 导入：可从 iPad 或 iPhone 上 Safari 自己导出的文件，或来自 Mac、Chrome、Firefox 的书签文件，将 Safari 书签连同文件夹一起导入收藏。
• 设置 › 影院模式 › 在任何网页上：在电视前使用键盘和鼠标时，不只是播放视频，在任何网页上，只要几秒钟不触碰屏幕，iPad 或 iPhone 就会变暗。亮度设为 0% 时，屏幕会全黑。轻点屏幕即可恢复。
• 在 iPhone 上，音量条调节的是 iPhone 本身的音量；通过 AirPlay 时，这就是电视的音量。

更流畅
• 无论页面缩放多少，包括在 iPhone 上，点按都会落在你瞄准的位置；字幕、画质等视频播放器菜单一点就开，并保持打开。
• 滚动比电视更宽的网页时不再左右偏移，点按会准确落在你瞄准的位置。
• 地址栏打开时，点按电视上的输入框会把键盘交给该输入框，你输入的内容会进入登录处，而不是地址里。

修复
• 在 iOS 27 上，轻点电视上的输入栏或键盘按钮时，键盘会重新出现，“ScreenCommand 使用方法”也会重新显示教程。
• 在 YouTube 上，从 iPad 或 iPhone 暂停或播放全屏视频后，全屏按钮会正确显示“退出全屏”，轻点一次即可退出。
• 使用鼠标时，一次点按只算一次（视频会暂停，Aa 和盾牌菜单会保持打开），滚轮会让页面保持居中、不出现黑边，鼠标也会一直留在电视上，直到你自己把它交给 iPad。
• Vimeo 视频重新能在电视上播放：在并未要求验证的 Vimeo 页面上，iPad 或 iPhone 不会再打开“在此验证”。

有问题或建议？support@screencommand.app
cn.description:
电视或显示器上的完整桌面级浏览器，iPad 或 iPhone 就是触控板和键盘。有线连接还能看 Netflix、Prime Video 等流媒体。无需电脑，一次买断，无需订阅。
必须连接外接显示器或电视。ScreenCommand 自带的浏览器以电视的完整分辨率铺满全屏，没有黑边。它不是你屏幕的复制，其他 App 也无法在电视上运行。没有接显示器时，App 只会打开“连接外接显示器”设置页面，无法在设备上单独浏览。

有线连接：USB-C 接口的 iPad，或 iPhone 15 及更新机型和 iPhone Duo（iPhone 16e、iPhone 17e 和 iPhone Air 除外），配合 USB-C 转 HDMI 或 DisplayPort 转接头。包装盒里的充电线不能传输视频。

AirPlay：任何 iPad 或 iPhone，需要你的 Wi-Fi 网络中有一台 Apple TV 盒子（不是 App）。在 ScreenCommand 打开的状态下启动“屏幕镜像”，电视上只显示浏览器。网站、YouTube 和其他网页视频都能播放，光标略有延迟。流媒体服务需要有线连接。

任何 USB-C 接口的 iPad 都能用，哪怕没有 M 系列芯片、用不了 iPadOS 扩展显示器。8 种光标样式、最多 12 个常驻标签页、两个网页并排显示、YouTube 画质最高 4K、字幕、下载，以及可以清除的浏览历史。也支持实体键盘，在 iPad 上还能用鼠标。

外接大屏，无缝衔接
• 在外接显示器上完整浏览网页
• 自动识别显示器，即插即用
• 针对 1080p、4K 与带鱼屏优化

进阶光标与操控
• 八种精致光标样式：默认、赛博霓虹、优雅玻璃、液态水晶、电竞专业、奢华金、绚丽极光、极简暗色
• 顺滑的触控板操作，支持手势
• iPad 支持蓝牙或 USB 鼠标与触控板
• 双指自然滚动
• 精准的单击、双击与右键操作

智能键盘输入
• 完整键盘支持，填网页表单、搜东西都顺手
• 支持实体键盘输入，以及 ⌘L、⌘T、⌘R 等快捷键
• 智能地址栏：网址、搜索词都能直接输入
• 自动识别并聚焦输入框

媒体控制
• 轻点一下播放/暂停视频
• 随时切换 YouTube 画质：最高 4K（2160p），全屏下也能调
• 用屏幕滑块调节媒体音量
• 拖动进度条，想看哪儿点哪儿
• 一键切换全屏
• 影院模式（Cinema Mode），观影不受打扰

强大的浏览功能
• 最多 4 个浏览器窗口，每个 12 个标签页，关掉 App 也会保留
• 在电视上并排显示两个窗口
• 密码自动填充，在电视上轻松登录
• 桌面模式，网站显示更完整
• 「支持情况」告诉你设备如何连接
• 阻止网页强行跳转到其他 App
• 弹出式窗口拦截，可按网站单独关闭

个性化
• 光标大小可调（0.2x - 5.0x）
• 鼠标速度可调，要精准还是要快随你（0.5x - 5.0x）
• 自定义主页网址
• 接上显示器自动打开浏览器

隐私优先
• 不收集任何数据，不做追踪
• 没有第三方分析
• 所有处理都在你的设备本地完成
• 无需联网（浏览网页时除外）

适合这些人：
• 需要更大工作区的职场人士
• 想在大屏上查资料的学生
• 打理社交媒体的内容创作者
• 任何想用 iPad 或 iPhone 获得桌面级浏览体验的人

怎么用：
1. 把 iPad 或 iPhone 接到外接显示器（USB-C 直连或 HDMI 转接头），也可以通过 AirPlay 连接 Apple TV 盒子
2. 打开 ScreenCommand
3. 浏览器会自动出现在外接显示器上
4. 把 iPad 或 iPhone 当作触控板与操控中心
5. 尽情享受桌面级浏览！

系统要求：
• 带 USB-C 接口、运行 iPadOS 17.0 或更高版本的 iPad（无需 M 系列芯片）
• 或运行 iOS 17.0 或更高版本的 iPhone。有线连接需支持 USB-C 视频输出（iPhone 15 及更新机型，iPhone 16e、iPhone 17e 和 iPhone Air 除外）；任何 iPhone 都可使用 AirPlay
• 外接显示器或电视
• USB-C 转 HDMI/DisplayPort 转接头（或 USB-C 直连），或一台 Apple TV 盒子用于 AirPlay 无线连接（有线连接光标延迟最低，更推荐）

ScreenCommand 把真正的桌面级浏览带到 iPad 或 iPhone 的外接屏幕上。

Spaceclear 帮你找出占满 iPhone 的内容，并优雅地清理干净。一切都在你的设备上完成：无需账户，没有服务器，也没有追踪。一次付费，无需订阅。

清理照片

通讯录和日历

Pay-per-book: Your first notebook with unlimited pages is included with your initial purchase, and you can add up to four more books for a one-time fee of $1.99 each. All features included, forever. No subscriptions, ever. That is a promise. 

TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook into the digital world, with smart tools to find your notes whenever you need them and endless ways to make it yours. All topped off with stunning cover art options made by real humans and endless ways to personalise your notebook.

No account required. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Opens to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. To enter swipe the book cover or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget. 

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Link Notes, add photos, PDFs, timestamps, checklists, titles, bullet points and more to your notes. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way around.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout. 

- Make it yours! Pick lined, grid, blank or dotted paper and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts, choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts or even upload your own. And if that’s not enough, turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour for all pages or just one specific page, and go wild. Ooh, and wait until you’ve seen our gorgeous Dark Mode.

- Choose from beautiful cover artworks from our own TypeDraw collection or explore premium art from illustrators like Gabor Estefan and make your notebook something truly satisfying to look at every time you open it. Take that, generative AI!

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too, and you can reorder them with a simple drag and drop.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

cn.description:
NaviBeat brings your own music library to every Apple device you own: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch, plus CarPlay, as a single Universal Purchase. Pay once.

No subscriptions. No ads. No tracking. No NaviBeat cloud. Your music stays on your own server, exactly where you put it. NaviBeat just plays it, beautifully.

ABOUT NAVIDROME

NaviBeat is a client for Navidrome, the free and open-source self-hosted music server. Run Navidrome on a NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS or any machine you control, and NaviBeat streams your collection to every Apple device. Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic and any OpenSubsonic server work too.

ON iPHONE & iPAD
- Browse artists, albums, playlists and genres
- Voice and text search with live results
- Now Playing with synced lyrics
- Background audio, Control Center, AirPlay, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets
- Offline: keep a song, an album, a playlist or a whole artist on the device
- Listening Stats: a 24-hour clock, a weekday heatmap, your top artists and songs
- Smart Playlists you write yourself, from rating, genre, year, play count and more, kept current and synced across your devices
- Start on one device and carry on with another. The device you left pauses itself

IN THE CAR

- Full CarPlay support, included in the same purchase
- Your library, playlists, downloads and Now Playing on the car screen
- Voice search that resolves the play command against your own library, not a streaming catalogue, in every language the app ships

ON MAC

- A real Mac app, not a phone app in a window
- A Mini Player that pins over any window
- Keyboard shortcuts, multi-window and directory browsing, desktop widgets
- NaviSyncRock: sync your library to a Rockbox player. Your server does the transcoding, art is re-encoded so it renders, and plays sync back. A separate one-time in-app unlock.

ON APPLE TV

- Cinema-scale artwork and discovery shelves
- Recently Played, Most Played, Rediscover, On This Day, Because You Listened To
- Voice search via the Siri Remote
- Full-screen Now Playing with synced lyrics

ON APPLE WATCH

- Now Playing complications on any watch face
- Music stored on the watch and played from it, so you can run without your iPhone
- Downloads pulled straight from your server over Wi-Fi

AUDIO

- Selectable high-fidelity playback engine
- 10-band equalizer with presets
- ReplayGain volume normalisation, per track or per album
- Gapless playback
- Streaming quality set separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, in Opus, AAC and MP3 tiers, or send the original file untouched
- Internet radio

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY

- Multi-library Navidrome support: All Libraries, a single library, or any subset, filtered on the server
- Star ratings synced to your server
- Classical music: automatic work and movement grouping
- Optional Last.fm and ListenBrainz integration. Scrobbles route through your own server, never directly from the app.
- Server Health diagnostics: server type, version, OpenSubsonic extensions, scan status

REACHING YOUR SERVER

Built for a locked-down homelab. Custom HTTP headers for Cloudflare Access and Authelia, mTLS client certificates, and access over Tailscale all work, on every platform, with no third-party relay in between.

MULTIPLE LANGUAGES

The app comes in multiple languages, with an in-app language picker on every platform.

REQUIREMENTS

NaviBeat requires a running Navidrome server (v0.50 or later, free and open source) accessible from your Apple device. Self-host it on a home NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS, or any machine you control. See navibeat.app for setup.

NaviBeat is a third-party client, not affiliated with the Navidrome project.

PRIVACY

NaviBeat collects zero data. There is no NaviBeat backend, no analytics, no telemetry and no third-party SDKs. Your credentials live in your device's Keychain. Your listening history stays on device. See navibeat.app/privacy.

Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app.

With over 20,000 precision-cut, chord-based loops across 15 diverse Jazz Fusion styles included, the app instantly converts the chords you select into great-sounding audio - wherever you are and whatever your ability. Perfect for songwriters and producers and the ultimate play-along for jazz rock and pop instrumentalists.

Highly acclaimed, multi award-winning pianist Tom Cawley is one of the most sought-after keyboard players in the world both as a jazz pianist (Dave Weckl, Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker...), and as a leading pop/rock keyboardist, recording and performing around the world with U2, Peter Gabriel, Andrea Bocelli, Amy Winehouse and many others.

For this special Jazz Fusion edition, Tom is joined by 2 of the world's top session musicians: Simon Lea – Drums (Rod Stewart, Dionne Warwick, James Blunt, James Morrison, Katie Melua...) and Geoff Gascoyne – Bass (Sting, Van Morrison, Georgie Fame...).

Tom's passion for jazz and for modern and vintage keys is reflected in the diverse range of styles in this edition. And Tom has employed many of the best keyboards from his vast personal collection: from the Oberheim OB-6, Prophet 12 and Moog Model D (as well as a modular set-up), to his vintage Fender Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Hohner Pianet - they all feature in the content of this app. And to do full justice to this genre, we have increased the number of chord variations to 15 for every root note in all 15 styles!

Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier.

Create professional Jazz Fusion to your own choice of chords in minutes. Everything you need to create and share thousands of stunning royalty-free tracks.

Hear the results. Watch the video at sessionbandapp.com

The fastest way to create your own studio-quality music:

• Auto-transpose your entire track

cn.releaseNotes:
YOUR BACKUPS AT A GLANCE
The main screen is rebuilt around what's most relevant: whether a backup is running, how long it will take, and what all your backups have added up to.

MIRRORING
Photos and Files backups can now follow your library and folders: items you delete leave the backup too. A Deleted folder keeps them first, for as long as you choose.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
The main screen meets the fold with the status on one half and the controls on the other, and fits the outer screen when closed.

SHORTCUTS AND SIRI, REIMAGINED
A new Start Backup action replaces Start Photo Backup and Start File Backup, joined by actions to stop a backup and ask how it is going. Your existing shortcuts keep working.
 ALSO IN THIS UPDATE
• The Live Activity has been redesigned.
• Much improved error reporting.
• New progress sounds. You can turn them off in Settings.
• Many other small improvements and bug fixes.
• Version 2.0.1: Minor fixes and new screenshots.

Version 2.0.2
• New: Option to keep deleted items forever.
• Fixed a crash shortly after starting a backup.
• More reliable mirroring, free space and progress for network share Destinations.

Version 2.0.3
• Drive or network share not connected? Parachute Backup now tells you which destination to connect, in the app, on the Lock Screen and in a notification. The backup continues on its own once it is back.
• Backups started from Shortcuts now wait for a network share that takes a while to reconnect, instead of stopping.
• When your cloud storage asks you to sign in again, the backup stops right away instead of waiting for hours. Sign in from the main screen and the backup runs again.
• The Keep Items duration for mirrored Files backups no longer snaps back to 90 Days.
• Photos Settings on iPhone now shows your changes right away.
• The Destination row shows drive or share and folder, like "NAS ▸ Backups".
• Fixed random characters in front of some network share names.

Version 2.0.4
• When a download from iCloud stalls, a countdown now shows how long Parachute Backup waits for it.
• Stop now ends a backup right away, also while it waits for a download.
• Unchanged items in OneDrive folders with more than 200 items are no longer uploaded again on every backup.
• Items with "%20" in their name now copy to S3 instead of failing with a permission error.
• Network shares: Start Backup in Shortcuts no longer reports an error while the backup waits for the share, and you get one notification instead of two when the wait runs out.
• A document that a network share refused to replace is no longer reported as a Photos library that is not included.

Version 2.0.5
• Fixes a blank screen on iPadOS 27.3 beta.
• Some NAS models do not provide a folder listing to iPhone and iPad. Parachute Backup now detects that situation, keeps backing up, and tells you why deletions cannot be mirrored.
• Before you add a folder on a NAS as a Destination, Parachute Backup now checks it for known problems and tells you about them.
• When a photo or video fails to copy, you now see whether it comes from the Photo Library or from a shared album, and which album.
• A backup that lasts less than a second no longer shows 0 s.
cn.description:
Parachute is your backup companion for iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive. It backs up your memories — photos, videos, and documents — to storage you control, whether that’s an external drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 Buckets, network drives/NAS, external hard drives and more. With Parachute, you get peace of mind and full ownership of your data, free from lock-in.

Your Data, Your Way
	•	Back up your entire iCloud Photos library (including Shared Albums) and folders from iCloud Drive.
	•	Preserve originals in full resolution, all adjustment data, and the current edited versions.
	•	Works with USB drives, NAS/SMB/SFTP mounts, Google Drive, S3 Buckets, OneDrive, external hard drives and more

Key Features
	•	Backups can be triggered from the main screen to any of your backup destinations
	•	Automate backups with Shortcuts integration and Schedules
	•	Privacy-first: transfers handled via Apple’s Files extensions — your credentials never touch our app.
	•	Supports full-quality media: Live Photos + videos, RAW images, bursts, edits, and slow motion.

Why It Matters
	•	iCloud sync ≠ backup — deletions, expired storage, or sync errors can mean permanent loss.
	•	Parachute safeguards your digital life from accidents and disasters.
	•	Your files are stored in normal folders you can browse and restore from directly — no special tools needed.

One time purchase. No Lock-In.
	•	One-time purchase unlocks all backup functionality — no recurring fees.
	•	Your data stays in your storage, not ours.
	•	No accounts, no telemetry, no background bloat.


FAQ Highlights

Q: Does Parachute ever delete files from iCloud?
A: Never. It’s strictly read-only.

Q: Can I restore without Parachute?
A: Yes. Backups are just normal folders — copy them back with Finder anytime.

Q: What if a file is corrupted in iCloud?
A: Parachute flags any unexportable items so you know exactly what couldn’t be saved.

Q: Can it back up non-iCloud folders?
A: Yes. Add any folder via the iOS/iPadOS file picker

By downloading Parachute Backup, you agree to Apple's Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and our Privacy Policy (https://parachuteapps.com/privacy).

cn.description:
Solo is the ultimate practice App for mastering fretboard visualization, designed by world renowned guitarists Tom Quayle and David Beebee.

Four powerful fretboard trainers allow you to work intuitively on each aspect of the visualization process; learning note names, memorising interval shapes, outlining chord changes, and practicing scales.

Solo asks you to find intervallic functions against one root note, chord symbol or scale at a time, listens to the notes you play, and doesn’t move on until you’ve correctly found each note by its intervallic function in the specified order.

Practice with Solo and finally learn your note names, master interval shapes, confidently play through chord changes and break out of scale boxes with intervallic functions. Start transforming your playing and confidence on the fretboard today!


NOTE TRAINER
The Note Trainer is perfect for beginner and intermediate players getting to grips with note names on the neck - the foundation of solid fretboard knowledge. 

‣ Solo shows you random root notes to find and listens, waiting for you to get it correct.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Optional practice suggestions offer challenging ways to limit and test yourself.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


INTERVAL TRAINER
The Interval Trainer will help players at all levels work on interval shapes with intervallic functions - the key to unlocking true freedom on the fretboard.

‣ Choose any combination of intervallic functions to practice.
‣ Create custom interval groups or choose the intervals for ANY chord type or scale.
‣ The Interval Trainer will randomise your chosen intervals and ask you to find them against either a fixed or random root note.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams, showing you where all of the interval shapes are across the neck, and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


CHANGES TRAINER
In the Changes Trainer you find intervallic functions, using single notes to outline different chord types or sets of chord changes, a key skill for learning to improvise through chord changes.  

‣ Practice outlining intervallic functions through over 100 common chord progressions and single chord exercises.
‣ 50 intervallic function levels. Go from simple chord tones to complex melodic structures and scales. 
‣ Solo intelligently maps out the correct intervals over each chord and listens for you to play each intervallic function in the specified order.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Transpose the key of any progression or exercise. 
‣ Choose to randomly transpose the progression (or single chord exercise) each time it repeats.
‣ Work on voice leading chord tones through single note lines.


SCALE TRAINER
The Scale Trainer contains a vast array of scales and powerful workout options, allowing you to finally break out of the box and develop a much deeper understanding of how scales are constructed on the fretboard.

‣ Practice finding scales on the fretboard using intervallic functions. 
‣ Over 50+ Scales and modes.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Melodic sequence options let you focus on starting from any chord tone within the scale.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.

cn.description:
Just Press Record 是终极录音应用，只需一键即可录音、转写并通过 iCloud 在所有设备上同步。 你可以编辑音频并且直接在应用内转写文本，还可通过 Siri 直接开始录制新内容！

生活充满了我们不愿忘记的时刻——比如你的孩子说的第一句话、一次重要的会议、一次灵光乍现。 在 iPhone、iPad、Mac 以及 Apple Watch 上便捷的记录这些瞬间。

录音
• 一键即可开始、停止、暂停、继续录音。
• 通过快捷指令、Siri、小组件、三维触控的“快速操作”或 URL 方案来开始和停止录音。
• 录音时间无限制。
• 在后台仍可录音。
• 可选择录音源为内置麦克风、AirPods 或外置麦克风。
• 在 Apple Watch 上独立录音并可之后再同步。

播放
• 在播放过程中向后和向前快速查找。
• 播放速度可调节。

转写
• 将语音识别为可搜索的文字。
• 支持超过 30 种语言，与您设备的语言设置无关。
• 同步文本突出显示和音频播放。
• 在录音时可以识别标点符号口令。

编辑
• 音频 - 以波形视图显示音频，让你可以去掉不需要的部分。
• 文本 - 对转写文本内容进行修改和添加。

分享
• 将音频和文字分享到其他应用。
• 作为视频片段简单分享到社交媒体。
• 通过 USB 连接线分享到 Mac 或 PC 上的 iTunes。
• 打印转写文本。
• 在其他应用中将音频文件分享到 Just Press Record。 

管理
• 查看最近的录音或按照日期时间浏览音频库。
• 按文件名或转写内容搜索。
• 用于快速访问 Apple Watch 录音的专用界面。
• 重命名录音。
• 支持 iPad 的 Slide Over 和 Split View 功能。
• 在应用图标上添加了显示未播放录音的数字。

存储
• 选择将录音存储在 iCloud Drive 或设备本地。
• 存储在 iCloud Drive 的录音将自动在所有设备间同步。
• 录音通过“文件”应用集成和自动 iTunes 文件分享存储在本地。
• 转写内容与音频文件共同储存。

专业音频
• 在支持的设备上通过内置麦克风进行立体声录音。
• 支持通过 Lightning Port 连接的高质量外置麦克风。
• 自定义音频设置以增强您的录音体验。
• 文件类型包括 WAV、AIF 及标准 iTunes M4A (ACC)。
• 音频质量最高可达 96kHz / 24-bit。

辅助功能
• 应用完全支持 VoiceOver 功能。
• 开始/停止录音支持智能手势操作。

Apple Watch
Just Press Record 包含一款 Apple Watch 应用，让你随时随地，即使 iPhone 不在身边，也可以自由录音。

• 轻点功能栏即可开始录音。
• 在后台仍可录音。
• 录音时间无限制。
• 录音自动传输到 iPhone 进行转写并同步到 iCloud。
• 通过内置喇叭或 AirPods 聆听最近的录音。
• 通过 Digital Crown 表冠调节音量。
• 向下滑动即可暂停录音。
• 支持 VoiceOver 辅助功能，降低动作幅度，支持超大功能栏模版。

重要事项:
• Just Press Record 不会录制电话通话内容和来自其他应用的音频。
• 转写功能仅对高质量、低噪音的音频内容有效。  避免录音环境过于嘈杂，将麦克风尽量靠近说话人。
• 您可以在我们的常见问题页面上了解 Just Press Record 的 URL 方案。

Daily tracking – see your progress over hours, days, and weeks
Real‑time reminders – without disturbing others
One payment. Lifetime access.


Unlike other devices that force you into monthly subscriptions, HiPee keeps it honest:

$4.99 (limited-time promotional price)
Regular price: $19.99 (one-time, not per month)
No in-app purchases – what you see is what you get
No ads, no hidden fees

Why charge for the app?
Because maintaining the app – iOS updates, bug fixes, feature improvements – costs us real time and money. This small fee ensures we can keep supporting your device for years。

cn.releaseNotes:
7.2 新功能
• “设置”中的“保持屏幕常亮”现在有三个选项：关闭、学习时和始终。选择“学习时”，查看公式、学习闪卡或练习时屏幕保持常亮，其他地方则照常变暗。如果你之前打开了这个开关，现在的选项是“始终”。
• 像 (R U R') 这样的括号组现在在测验、闪卡和“编辑公式”中保持在同一行，不再被拆成两行。

如果你错过了 7.1
• Cube CFOP 现已支持简体中文，以及越南语和德语。在“设置 > 语言”中选择，App 会立即切换。情况名称和记号保持魔友惯用的写法。
• 双面 PLL 测验：像手中拿着魔方一样，从顶面和两个侧面认出 PLL 情况。
• 随机前面颜色：PLL 识别和双面 PLL 测验的新选项，与随机 AUF 并列，让每种情况以各种配色出现。两个选项默认关闭，每个测验会记住你的选择。
• OLL 识别、PLL 识别和双面 PLL 测验现在会把每种情况都问一遍，然后才重复。答错或跳过的情况会在几题之后再次出现。
• 复制公式：从任意公式的菜单中复制，方便粘贴到计时器或笔记中。
• 现在可以删除侧面视角的最后一条公式。前视角始终保留一条。
• OLL 2-Look 第一步的情况现在命名为 L-shape、Line 和 Dot，取代 1-1、1-2 和 1-3。

如果你错过了 7.0.1
• OLL 和 PLL 情况新增四个视角：前、右、后、左。每个视角都从该侧绘制并以 3D 播放，并保存你为它编写的公式。在侧面视角中，“从前视角生成”会根据你的前视角公式写出该视角的公式。

如果你错过了 7.0
Cube CFOP 7.0 全面重做，带来学习和练习每种情况的新方式。

• 学习中：全新的标签页，提供四档评分闪卡（重来、困难、良好、简单）、每日复习，以及连续学习天数和学习日报告。
• 练习：OLL 识别和 PLL 识别、F2L 角块测验，以及计时练习。
• 公式：在 3D 魔方上观看任意公式，添加自己的别名和备注，并搜索所有情况。编辑器会检查公式能否还原该情况。
• 指南：从概览到 PLL 的 CFOP 方法、3D 魔方上的还原示例、Finger trick，以及重新绘制的记号指南。
• 另外：你的魔方配色和握法、浅色和深色外观、iPhone Duo 和 iPad 双栏布局、键盘快捷键，以及全新的 App 图标。
• 不收集使用数据。App 只发送崩溃报告。

你的收藏、编辑过的公式和闪卡进度都会保留。你的公式列表保持不变；如需使用新的推荐公式，请前往“设置 > 恢复默认公式”。
cn.description:
一次学一种情况，掌握最流行的速拧方法 CFOP。收录全部 F2L、OLL 和 PLL 公式，配合闪卡、测验和计时练习，帮你牢牢记住公式。

CFOP 的每一种情况
• 41 种 F2L、57 种 OLL 和 21 种 PLL 情况，另有 2-Look OLL 和 2-Look PLL 帮你入门。
• 许多情况提供备选公式：挑一条顺手的，或者自己编写。编辑器会检查公式能否还原该情况。
• 在 3D 魔方上观看任意公式，轻点某一步即可播放到那一步。
• 从四个视角查看任意 F2L、OLL 或 PLL 情况，并为每个视角编写或生成公式。
• 每种情况都有 Setup，还可添加你自己的别名和备注。
• 按名称、别名、分组或备注搜索。

用闪卡学习
• 把正在练习的情况加入“学习中”。
• 间隔重复会在卡片到期时再次出示它。评分为重来、困难、良好或简单。
• 随时练习困难卡片、新卡片或随机卡片。
• 报告：学习日热力图、连续学习天数，以及未来 7 天的到期内容。

练到形成肌肉记忆
• OLL 识别和 PLL 识别：看图案说出情况名称，并计时。
• 双面 PLL 测验：像手中拿着魔方一样，从顶面和两个侧面认出 PLL 情况。
• 随机 AUF 和随机前面颜色：让每种情况带着转动过的顶层、以各种配色出现。
• F2L 角块测验：推断角块被遮住的色块。
• 计时练习：为一种情况计时，刷新你的个人最佳。

指南
• CFOP 方法循序渐进：概览、Cross、F2L、OLL 和 PLL。Cross 指南从小雏菊（daisy）讲起，帮你完成第一个 cross。
• 还原示例：在 3D 魔方上观看一次完整还原，每一步和每种情况都有标注。
• 记号：每个转动都在魔方上演示。
• Finger trick：快速转动背后的 trigger 和握法。

适合你的转法
• 你的魔方配色和握持方式。
• 浅色、深色或跟随系统外观。
• 英语、越南语、简体中文或德语，可在 App 内直接切换。
• 可在 iPhone、iPad 和 iPhone Duo 上使用，宽屏采用双栏布局，并支持硬件键盘快捷键。

一次购买。无广告、无订阅、无需账户，也不收集使用数据。

cn.releaseNotes:
Make every screen your own. Deco 3.0 brings a fresh look and more ways to turn your ideas into wallpapers, widgets and watch faces—with flexible sizes and iCloud to keep your creations close. Free to download, with even more to explore through Deco Plus.

Editing

- Clearer placement and spacing for adjustment labels when editing backgrounds and stickers.
- Clearer sticker previews in light and dark mode, with smoother transitions when switching editing controls.
- Easier access to Save while editing, with the status bar hidden.
- Refined canvas transitions when opening a creation or switching iPhone Duo displays.

Previews and exports

- Swipeable wallpaper and widget preview stacks with clearer edges, and a compact device menu for wallpapers.
- Simpler iPhone Duo orientation controls, with universal or separate inner and outer display exports.
- Wallpaper previews match the display you’re using when you fold or unfold iPhone Duo.
- Smoother transitions when Live effect previews repeat.

Settings and links

- On supported devices, widgets and wallpapers are named automatically by default.
- Simpler iCloud status in Settings.
- Direct links to tabs and Explore articles, with a fix for errors when opening Deco through its app link.

Fixes

- Fixed wallpaper deletion getting stuck while checking sharing.
- Fixed photo widgets turning sideways when reopened after saving.

Availability changes

- The free wallpaper allowance is now one wallpaper.
- Removed the companion Apple Watch app. Apple Watch face export remains available on iPhone.
cn.description:
Make wallpapers, widgets, and watch faces with your photos, text, emoji, and stickers. Create something for your own screens or share it with friends.

MAKE IT YOURS
Start with a photo, a gradient, stripes, or a solid color. Turn photo cutouts, words, and emoji into stickers. Choose fonts, colors, outlines, and finishes, then move, resize, rotate, and layer your stickers.

WALLPAPERS, WIDGETS, AND WATCH FACES
Make wallpapers for iPhone and iPad or choose custom dimensions. Create Home Screen widgets with a separate layout for each size. Export your artwork as an Apple Watch face. Use your saved stickers in Messages, too.

CREATE AND SHARE
Send an image, share an editable copy, or invite friends to a shared creation. Choose who can view or edit. Friends can join for free.

ADD MOVEMENT AND TEXTURE
Create Live Photo wallpapers with animated sticker effects. Try finishes including chrome, holographic, glitter, embroidery, and risograph, and preview animations as you work.

KEEP YOUR COLLECTION WITH YOU
Keep your creations and sticker library across your devices with iCloud. Search for artwork by what its images show, explore guides and ideas, and use Shortcuts to create and work with your designs.

DECO PLUS
Start free with up to three wallpapers, two widgets, and ten saved stickers. Unlock more with Deco Plus, available as a one-time purchase. Every price option includes the same Plus features. If you bought Deco before version 3.0, you keep your paid access.

hk.description:
Sorapuff 是一位溫柔的飛行夥伴，專為怕搭飛機的你而設計。登機前，它會告訴你航線上哪裡可能出現顛簸；在空中，它會離線為你解釋每一下顛簸，Sora 一直陪在你身邊。

起飛之前
• 航線亂流預報，由你的 iPhone 根據免費的公開氣象資料（NOAA）計算
• 一段一段告訴你是平穩、輕微還是中度顛簸，用白話說清楚：「前兩個小時可能很平穩」
• 沿途的雷雨警告（SIGMET）和最新機師報告
• 航線地圖，標出每段顛簸區域、雷雨和機師報告（Pro）
• 提醒：預報準備好時、開啟飛航模式前記得儲存，以及登機時

在空中，飛航模式下也能用
• 大大的航班追蹤：你在哪裡、還要飛多久、接下來會發生什麼
• 讓人安心的顛簸計，測量每一下顛簸，告訴你它其實有多小。機翼的設計承受能力是 2.5 g
• Sora 為每個階段準備的小叮嚀，從滑行到降落
• 顛簸路段前 10 分鐘先告訴你，不讓你措手不及

當你覺得有點撐不住時
• 只要點一下：和 Sora 一起呼吸，用輕柔緩慢的觸覺回饋感受每一次呼吸，一步一步讓自己平靜下來
• 可選用的舒緩音樂，在你的 iPhone 上即時生成
• 可從主畫面、Siri、捷徑、動作按鈕和控制中心開啟

落地之後
• 你的顛簸報告：用文字記錄每一下顛簸，還有一張漂亮的卡片可以分享（「我飛到了！」）
• 每個勇敢的時刻都能收集天空卡片，還能幫 Sora 換上新裝扮

飛行的人幫助飛行的人
• 落地之後，輕點一下就能傳送這次航班的顛簸資料：匿名，只有兩個機場代碼、起飛時間和顛簸
• 每一次分享的航班，都會把預報和真實顛簸對照一遍，幫助它為下一位緊張的乘客變得更好

私密地找出你的航班
• 貼上訂位確認信、打開 PDF 或掃描登機證
• 或讓 Sorapuff 在你的行事曆中尋找訂位；如果你願意，也可以在你的 iPhone 上以唯讀方式搜尋你的電子郵件

從設計上保護隱私
• 不需帳號，沒有廣告，沒有追蹤，沒有分析
• 你的航班只保存在你的 iPhone 上

一次買斷
Sorapuff 可免費下載，包含顛簸計、航班追蹤、安心陪伴、呼吸練習和你的第一次航線預報。Sorapuff Pro 只需購買一次，免訂閱：無限次預報（最多提前 3 天）、航線地圖、全部天空卡片和裝扮、所有音樂風格、小工具和即時動態。支援家人共享。

Sorapuff 提供資訊與放鬆工具，不構成醫療建議：請隨時聽從機組人員的指示。

hk.trackName: Comic Weather: 搞笑天氣預報
hk.description:
Comic Weather 是一款 iPhone 天氣 App，把你的天氣預報畫成一頁漫畫。你頭頂的天空是開場的第一格，旁白在黃色旁白框裡總結這一天，接下來的時段與日子則在下方一格格展開。

墨線底下是來自 Apple Weather 的真實預報：目前天氣、未來一小時的降雨、未來 24 小時、未來 10 天，以及官方劇烈天氣警報。

【四種漫畫畫風】
• 四色網點：報攤漫畫的經典模樣。班戴網點、大膽的原色、厚重的黑墨。
• 泡泡糖花開：粉彩流行風。泡泡糖粉、薄荷綠與丁香紫，還有花朵與閃光。
• 巨城漫畫：濃密的漫畫墨線，勾勒高聳入雲的城市、燈火映照的街巷與風雲變幻的天空。
• 午夜之城：哥德式黑色風格。近乎全黑的紙頁、琥珀色燈光、雨中的尖塔。
換畫風就是把整個 App 重新印一遍：畫格、字體、天氣圖示、每一個小工具，還有 App 圖示。

【192 幅彩繪場景】
十二種天氣，各自畫成黎明、白天、黃昏與夜晚四個版本，四種畫風都有：從晴空與霧，到雪、風暴與酷熱。每個場景都會動起來：大雨傾瀉、濃霧湧來、燈火閃爍、閃電劈裂。開啟「減少動態效果」或「低耗電模式」時，場景會保持靜止。

【降雨，分秒必爭】
在 Apple Weather 提供逐分鐘資料的地區，會有一格畫出未來一小時的降雨圖：「12分鐘後開始下雨」。點一下「在鎖定畫面上顯示」，倒數就會移到鎖定畫面和動態島；也可以讓它為你的主要地點自動開始。

【日落預報】
是滿天火燒雲，還是啞火一場？新的一格會替下一場日落評等，從「啞火」到「史詩級」，附上滿分 100 分的分數、日落時間，以及黃金時刻開始與藍調時刻結束的時間。它會讀取 Apple Weather 的低雲、中雲與高雲，以及降雨、濕度和能見度，並告訴你原因：「高雲會染上霞光。」「雨後初晴，空氣如洗。」這是預報，不是保證。

【每種畫風，都有自己的聲音】
每種畫風都配有專屬個性，負責撰寫旁白與通知。隨時都能更換：
• 四色網點 × 戲精：「濃霧將這座城市整個吞沒。行路務必小心。」
• 泡泡糖花開 × 元氣：「起霧啦！整座城市在玩捉迷藏！」
• 巨城漫畫 × 熱血：「有霧。地圖還沒載入完成。」
• 午夜之城 × 冷面：「霧。世界切換成低畫質。」

【一格一格看預報】
• 目前天氣、體感溫度，以及今天的最高溫與最低溫
• 此時此刻：風與陣風、濕度、紫外線、氣壓、能見度、日出與日落
• 未來 24 小時逐時預報，附降雨機率
• 10 天預報。點一下任何一天，即可查看雨量、風速、紫外線指數、日出、日落與月相
• 官方機構發布的劇烈天氣警報（如有提供）
• 可儲存多個地點並滑動切換，用你的位置或城市名稱都行
• 單位由你決定：°C 或 °F；風速可選公里/小時、英里/小時、公尺/秒、節或蒲福風級；雨量、氣壓與距離單位也能自訂

【只在預報需要時才通知你】
• 在你選定的時間送上晨間簡報
• 降雨提醒：開始下雨之前、雨停之前都會通知
• 晚間行程建議：「明天晴天——來排個計畫吧」
• 劇烈天氣警報，以及明天酷熱或結霜時的提前提醒
• 今晚日落有望「絢爛」或「史詩級」時，約一小時前送上日落提醒
這些通知都是你的 iPhone 根據已下載的預報推算出來的。每一類都能個別開啟或關閉。

【小工具、Siri 與控制中心】
• 整頁漫畫（大）：畫格、接下來幾小時與未來幾天
• 連環漫畫（中）與單格漫畫（小）
• 鎖定畫面用的天氣符號
• 無論主畫面設為染色還是透明風格，每個小工具都好看
• 對 Siri 說「Comic Weather，會下雨嗎？」或「Comic Weather 天氣預報」，也能在「捷徑」中使用
• 此刻天氣：控制中心裡的按鈕，顯示你挑選的任何地點的氣溫

【分享這一格】
點一下，就能把今天的畫格印成圖片，傳到「訊息」或你的限時動態。

【說你的語言】
每個畫面、旁白、通知和小工具都支援 26 種語言，從 Español、Deutsch 到 हिन्दी、العربية、日本語和 Bahasa Melayu。

【從設計開始就重視隱私】
沒有帳號。沒有廣告。沒有追蹤。沒有分析。Comic Weather 只會要求取用你的大略位置，將它四捨五入至約 100 公尺，並直接傳送給氣象服務。Comic Weather 沒有伺服器。

【為 VoiceOver 與大字體打造】
VoiceOver 會朗讀每一格，「照實朗讀」則會給你不含笑話的預報。文字最大可放大到輔助使用的最大尺寸。

【離線也能看】
沒有訊號？你最後一次的預報會留在頁面上，並標示已經過了多久。

【免費試用，Full 版一次買斷】
四色網點畫風、10 天預報、降雨提醒和一個小型小工具都能免費使用。所有功能可免費試用 7 天，之後只要一次解鎖 Comic Weather Full（完整版）：所有畫風與旁白個性、日落預報、全部小工具，以及降雨倒數。沒有訂閱，沒有廣告。已經買過了？一切照舊屬於你。

天氣資料來自 Apple Weather，並以 MET Norway（挪威氣象研究所）作為備援。Apple Weather 是 Apple Inc. 的商標。

有問題或點子，歡迎來信：support@comicweather.app

hk.releaseNotes:
ScreenCommand 3.0 為電視帶來右鍵選單和手形指標、瀏覽記錄，點按也會落在你瞄準的位置。在 iOS 27 上，鍵盤恢復正常。

電視上的新功能
• 右鍵點按（在觸控板上雙指輕點，或滑鼠右鍵）會在電視上打開選單：在新分頁中打開連結、拷貝連結或影像位址、拷貝所選文字、貼上、返回、下一頁和重新整理。
• 指標移到連結和按鈕上時會變成手形（設定 › 軌跡板與指標 › 手形指標）。電視網址列有全螢幕按鈕，可在 設定 › 外接顯示器 › 電視上的全螢幕按鈕 中關閉。
• 你在 iPad 或 iPhone 上編輯的網址會像在文字欄位中一樣顯示在電視上：所選內容醒目標示，或顯示閃爍的游標。在電視上用滑鼠按一下可放置游標，拖移可選取，按兩下可選取一個字詞。
• 電視網址列中的盾牌：網頁無法正常運作時，可為螢幕上的網站或所有網站關閉彈出式視窗阻擋，開啟或關閉「阻擋所有彈出式視窗」，並查看該網頁上阻擋了多少個彈出式視窗。iPad 或 iPhone 網址列中的盾牌也有相同的開關。
• 電視網址列中的 − 和 + 會顯示網頁的縮放比例，點一下「重設」即可回到 100%。編輯網址時，用箭頭打開它；在登入頁面上，用鑰匙打開你儲存的密碼。

iPad 和 iPhone 上的新功能
• 瀏覽記錄：在 iPad 或 iPhone 上點一下「喜好項目」旁邊的時鐘，即可依日期查看並搜尋你在電視上開啟的網頁；電視上星號旁邊的時鐘會列出最新的網頁。可以再次開啟、滑動刪除，或清除過去 1 小時、過去 24 小時、過去 7 天、過去 4 週或全部的記錄。
• 設定 › 隱私權：清除瀏覽記錄，或清除 Cookie 和網站資料，以登出各網站並重新開始。
• 設定 › 喜好項目 › 從 Safari 匯入：可從 iPad 或 iPhone 上 Safari 自己輸出的檔案，或來自 Mac、Chrome、Firefox 的書籤檔案，將 Safari 書籤連同檔案夾一起匯入喜好項目。
• 設定 › 劇院模式 › 在任何網頁上：在電視前使用鍵盤和滑鼠時，不只是播放影片，在任何網頁上，只要幾秒鐘不觸碰螢幕，iPad 或 iPhone 就會變暗。亮度設為 0% 時，螢幕會全黑。點一下螢幕即可恢復。
• 在 iPhone 上，音量列調整的是 iPhone 本身的音量；透過 AirPlay 時，這就是電視的音量。

更流暢
• 不論頁面縮放多少，包括在 iPhone 上，點按都會落在你瞄準的位置；字幕、畫質等影片播放器選單一點就開，並保持開啟。
• 捲動比電視更寬的網頁時不再左右偏移，按一下會準確落在你瞄準的位置。
• 網址列開啟時，點按電視上的輸入欄位會把鍵盤交給該欄位，你輸入的內容會進入登入處，而不是網址裡。

修正
• 在 iOS 27 上，點一下電視上的輸入欄位或鍵盤按鈕時，鍵盤會重新出現，「ScreenCommand 使用說明」也會重新顯示教學。
• 在 YouTube 上，從 iPad 或 iPhone 暫停或播放全螢幕影片後，全螢幕按鈕會正確顯示「結束全螢幕」，點一下即可結束。
• 使用滑鼠時，一次點按只算一次（影片會暫停，Aa 和盾牌選單會保持開啟），滾輪會讓頁面保持置中、不出現黑邊，滑鼠也會一直留在電視上，直到你自己把它交給 iPad。
• Vimeo 影片重新能在電視上播放：在並未要求驗證的 Vimeo 頁面上，iPad 或 iPhone 不會再開啟「在此驗證」。

有問題或建議嗎？support@screencommand.app
hk.description:
電視或螢幕上的完整電腦級瀏覽器，iPad 或 iPhone 就是觸控板與鍵盤。透過線材還能播放 Netflix、Prime Video 等串流。不需要電腦，買斷制，無訂閱。
必須搭配外接螢幕或電視使用。ScreenCommand 自己的瀏覽器以電視的完整解析度填滿畫面，沒有黑邊。它不是你螢幕的複製畫面，其他 App 也無法在電視上執行。沒有接上顯示器時，App 只會開啟「連接外接顯示器」設定畫面，無法單獨在裝置上瀏覽。

有線連接：USB-C 的 iPad，或 iPhone 15 及更新機型和 iPhone Duo（iPhone 16e、iPhone 17e 與 iPhone Air 除外），搭配 USB-C 轉 HDMI 或 DisplayPort 轉接器。盒裝隨附的充電線無法傳輸影像。

AirPlay：任何 iPad 或 iPhone，需要你的 Wi-Fi 網路上有一台 Apple TV 盒子（不是 App）。在 ScreenCommand 開啟的狀態下開始「螢幕鏡像輸出」，電視上只會顯示瀏覽器。網站、YouTube 及其他網頁影片都能播放，指標略有延遲。串流服務需要有線連接。

任何 USB-C 的 iPad 都能用，就算沒有 M 系列晶片、無法使用 iPadOS 延伸顯示器也一樣。8 種游標樣式、最多 12 個常駐分頁、兩個網頁並排顯示、YouTube 畫質最高 4K、字幕、下載，以及可清除的瀏覽紀錄。也支援實體鍵盤，在 iPad 上還能用滑鼠。

外接螢幕，接上就用
• 在外接螢幕上完整瀏覽網頁
• 自動偵測顯示器，隨插即用
• 針對 1080p、4K 與超寬螢幕最佳化

進階游標與操控
• 八款出色的游標樣式：Default、Cyberpunk Neon、Elegant Glass、Liquid Crystal、Gaming Pro、Luxury Gold、Aurora Borealis、Minimal Dark
• 流暢的觸控板操作，支援手勢
• iPad 支援藍牙或 USB 滑鼠與觸控板
• 雙指自然捲動
• 精準支援點一下、點兩下與右鍵

智慧鍵盤輸入
• 完整鍵盤輸入，網頁表單與搜尋都好用
• 支援實體鍵盤輸入，以及 ⌘L、⌘T、⌘R 等快速鍵
• 智慧網址列：輸入網址或搜尋關鍵字都可以
• 自動偵測輸入欄位並對焦

媒體控制
• 一鍵播放／暫停影片
• 隨時切換 YouTube 畫質：最高 4K（2160p），全螢幕下也能調
• 以螢幕上的滑桿調整媒體音量
• 用直覺的進度列快轉、倒轉
• 支援切換全螢幕
• 劇院模式（Cinema Mode），觀影不受打擾

強大的瀏覽功能
• 最多 4 個瀏覽器視窗，每個 12 個分頁，關掉再開仍會保留
• 在電視上並排顯示兩個視窗
• 密碼自動填寫，在電視上輕鬆登入
• 桌面版模式，網站相容性更完整
• 「支援情況」告訴你裝置如何連接
• 避免網頁擅自跳轉到其他 App
• 彈出式視窗阻擋，可依網站個別關閉

個人化設定
• 可調整游標大小（0.2x - 5.0x）
• 可調整滑鼠速度（0.5x - 5.0x），要精準或要快都行
• 自訂首頁網址
• 接上螢幕時自動開啟瀏覽器

隱私優先
• 不收集資料，也不追蹤
• 沒有第三方分析
• 所有處理都在裝置本機完成
• 除了瀏覽網頁之外，不需要網路連線

最適合：
• 需要更大工作區的專業人士
• 想在大螢幕上查資料的學生
• 經營社群媒體的內容創作者
• 任何想用 iPad 或 iPhone 享受電腦級瀏覽的人

使用方式：
1. 把 iPad 或 iPhone 接到外接螢幕（USB-C 或 HDMI 轉接器），或透過 AirPlay 傳送到 Apple TV 盒子
2. 開啟 ScreenCommand
3. 瀏覽器會自動顯示在外接螢幕上
4. 把 iPad 或 iPhone 當成觸控板與操控中心
5. 盡情享受電腦級的瀏覽體驗！

系統需求：
• 具備 USB-C 連接埠、執行 iPadOS 17.0 或以上版本的 iPad（不需要 M 系列晶片）
• 或執行 iOS 17.0 或以上版本的 iPhone。若要用線材連接，需支援 USB-C 影像輸出（iPhone 15 或更新機型，iPhone 16e、iPhone 17e 與 iPhone Air 除外）；任何 iPhone 都能使用 AirPlay
• 外接螢幕或電視
• USB-C 轉 HDMI／DisplayPort 轉接器（或直接以 USB-C 連接），或以 Apple TV 盒子進行無線 AirPlay（建議使用有線連接，游標延遲最低）

ScreenCommand 讓 iPad 或 iPhone 的外接螢幕真正擁有電腦級的瀏覽體驗。

hk.releaseNotes: 最多 10 個畫面：有了 Skywall Full，iPad 和電視上除了 9 個畫面，現在也能選 10 個。在 iPhone 上，按住電視牆下方的頻道即可加入收藏。在頻道列表中，篩選項目現在直接在螢幕上展開，不再跑到側邊的螢幕外；全螢幕時，網格按鈕可帶你回到電視牆。發熱提醒不會再在打開 App 時出現，而是等幾個頻道播放一段時間後才顯示；「裝置發熱時減少畫面」現在預設關閉，除非你自行開啟。「回復購買」現在會告訴你結果：Skywall Full 已回復、沒有可回復的購買，或無法連線至 App Store。Skywall Full 購買畫面現在附有使用條款和隱私權政策的連結。App 內建的頻道列表也已更新。
hk.description:
Skywall 是一款多畫面 App，可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上以分割畫面並排同時觀看多個電視新聞台的直播。一個畫面最多放十個，想聽哪個就聽哪個，即時關注世界各地的新聞。

一次看更多
• 一個螢幕可顯示 1、2、4、6、9 或 10 個直播頻道，也可以一個大畫面周圍環繞多個小畫面
• iPhone 上最多 6 個頻道
• 點一下頻道即可收聽。只有一個頻道有聲音，其餘保持靜音
• 點一下頻道名稱即可轉台
• 點一下讓一個頻道填滿螢幕，返回也一樣快
• 頂部列可自動隱藏，把整個螢幕留給頻道

你的電視牆和收藏
• 為頻道組合命名並儲存，在你的電視牆之間切換
• 為喜歡的頻道加上星號，它們會一直排在頻道列表最前面
• 現成電視牆：英語國際新聞、西班牙語新聞、商業與財經市場
• 為選舉開票夜等重大事件準備的特別電視牆，無須更新 App 即可更新內容
• 電視牆、收藏和設定透過你自己的 iCloud 在 iPhone 和 iPad 之間同步

來自全球的頻道
• 來自數十個國家和地區的頻道：新聞、無線電視、體育、財經、地方、政府、即時影像等
• 即時直播的廣播電台
• 打開頻道列表，最先看到正在直播的頻道
• 依名稱搜尋，選擇國家/地區，並依類別和語言篩選
• 頻道資料來自維基百科：簡介、城市、網站
• 頻道列表持續更新，無須更新 App
• 找不到想看的頻道？可在 getskywall.app 提出申請

隨心使用
• 睡眠計時器：30、60 或 90 分鐘，或自訂時間
• 在 iPad 和 Mac 上支援鍵盤快速鍵

Grounds Up now speaks eight more languages: German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Dutch and Japanese. Every screen is translated, news and reviews included.
To switch, open Settings, Language in the game, pick a language and tap the button under it. Or open Settings, Grounds Up, Language in iOS.

Your saved games stay as they are.
hk.description:
Grounds Up is a single-player business tycoon game for iPhone. You open your first small café on a busy street. Each week you set prices, pay your people, pick your coffee and read the results. Then the company grows far beyond coffee: more cafés in more cities, hotels, an AI lab and a fund of your own.

Time moves only when you tap the date, one week at a time. There is no timer and no game over. Everything in the game is made up: the companies, the people, the banks and the money. It is a game, not a financial service, and nothing in it is financial advice.

A GROUP THAT KEEPS GROWING
• Build cafés in eight cities: Osaka, Tokyo, New York, Chicago, London, Paris, Berlin and São Paulo.
• Choose the look, the machines, the menu and the prices of every café, and hire managers to run them.
• Open hotels. Pick the class, the rooms and the rates, and read the guest reviews.
• Start an AI lab and grow it through research, products and funding rounds.
• Run a fund with outside investors and a record that sets the size of the next one.
• Lease offices, buy property, and buy and name landmarks.

STAKES, BOARDS AND VOTES
• Buy shares in listed companies and back startups through their funding rounds.
• Build a stake big enough for a seat on the board, then more seats, then the chair.
• Sit in board meetings. Read the facts, weigh the options and vote, or let your seats vote for you.
• Win control of a company and merge it into your group.

RIVALS AND RECORDS
• 300 rival tycoons grow their own fortunes while you build yours.
• Climb the rich list and chase records, from your first billion up.
• Play Relaxed, Normal, Hard or Tycoon, with up to five rival companies.

PAY ONCE, NOTHING ELSE TO BUY
• One payment on the App Store.
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscription.
• Works offline. The game never needs the internet.
• No account. No tracking. Keep up to ten games on your phone.

All companies, people and money in the game are made up. Nothing here is financial advice.

hk.releaseNotes:
Full-width Portrait Mode! Overdue, yes, but now it’s finally here! On iPhone Duo and iPad, you can now use the full width of your device as a canvas for your thoughts.

We’re also introducing a new Cover Art Collection by iconic content creator Basic Apple Guy, featuring 5 "ugly" Christmas Sweaters to dress up your notebooks, plus “Skybird,” a new font to choose from!

We’ve also been working hard under the hood, fixing bugs and making everything feel smoother. Thank you for your feedback and patience. We’ll keep on improving!

Also in this version:
- You can now paste images with transparent backgrounds
- While drawing, the canvas automatically expands to give you endless space
- You can now completely remove a note from your notebook
hk.description:
Pay-per-book: Your first notebook with unlimited pages is included with your initial purchase, and you can add up to four more books for a one-time fee of $1.99 each. All features included, forever. No subscriptions, ever. That is a promise. 

TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook into the digital world, with smart tools to find your notes whenever you need them and endless ways to make it yours. All topped off with stunning cover art options made by real humans and endless ways to personalise your notebook.

No account required. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Opens to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. To enter swipe the book cover or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget. 

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Link Notes, add photos, PDFs, timestamps, checklists, titles, bullet points and more to your notes. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way around.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout. 

- Make it yours! Pick lined, grid, blank or dotted paper and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts, choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts or even upload your own. And if that’s not enough, turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour for all pages or just one specific page, and go wild. Ooh, and wait until you’ve seen our gorgeous Dark Mode.

- Choose from beautiful cover artworks from our own TypeDraw collection or explore premium art from illustrators like Gabor Estefan and make your notebook something truly satisfying to look at every time you open it. Take that, generative AI!

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too, and you can reorder them with a simple drag and drop.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

FIND YOUR CLOCKS
The app finds AWTRIX NG clocks in your Wi-Fi. You can also add a clock by its address.

SEE AND CONTROL
- See what your clock shows, live.

- Start and stop scripts and games.

AWTRIX HUB BUILT IN
Browse scripts and icons made by the community. The Hub shows only what runs on your clock and installs it with one tap.

PLAY WITH YOUR PHONE
Turn your phone into a gamepad for games on the clock. Two phones can play together.

TALK TO YOUR CLOCK
Record a short voice message and play it on clocks with a speaker.

SHARE TO YOUR CLOCK
Send text and pictures from other apps to your clock, or save a picture as an icon.

IPHONE NOTIFICATIONS ON THE TC002
The Ulanzi TC002 connects to your iPhone over Bluetooth. It shows your notifications and the music that is playing. You choose which apps appear.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The app talks to your clocks directly in your home network. No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

Requires a clock running the AWTRIX NG firmware.

hk.description:
NaviBeat brings your own music library to every Apple device you own: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch, plus CarPlay, as a single Universal Purchase. Pay once.

No subscriptions. No ads. No tracking. No NaviBeat cloud. Your music stays on your own server, exactly where you put it. NaviBeat just plays it, beautifully.

ABOUT NAVIDROME

NaviBeat is a client for Navidrome, the free and open-source self-hosted music server. Run Navidrome on a NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS or any machine you control, and NaviBeat streams your collection to every Apple device. Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic and any OpenSubsonic server work too.

ON iPHONE & iPAD
- Browse artists, albums, playlists and genres
- Voice and text search with live results
- Now Playing with synced lyrics
- Background audio, Control Center, AirPlay, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets
- Offline: keep a song, an album, a playlist or a whole artist on the device
- Listening Stats: a 24-hour clock, a weekday heatmap, your top artists and songs
- Smart Playlists you write yourself, from rating, genre, year, play count and more, kept current and synced across your devices
- Start on one device and carry on with another. The device you left pauses itself

IN THE CAR

- Full CarPlay support, included in the same purchase
- Your library, playlists, downloads and Now Playing on the car screen
- Voice search that resolves the play command against your own library, not a streaming catalogue, in every language the app ships

ON MAC

- A real Mac app, not a phone app in a window
- A Mini Player that pins over any window
- Keyboard shortcuts, multi-window and directory browsing, desktop widgets
- NaviSyncRock: sync your library to a Rockbox player. Your server does the transcoding, art is re-encoded so it renders, and plays sync back. A separate one-time in-app unlock.

ON APPLE TV

- Cinema-scale artwork and discovery shelves
- Recently Played, Most Played, Rediscover, On This Day, Because You Listened To
- Voice search via the Siri Remote
- Full-screen Now Playing with synced lyrics

ON APPLE WATCH

- Now Playing complications on any watch face
- Music stored on the watch and played from it, so you can run without your iPhone
- Downloads pulled straight from your server over Wi-Fi

AUDIO

- Selectable high-fidelity playback engine
- 10-band equalizer with presets
- ReplayGain volume normalisation, per track or per album
- Gapless playback
- Streaming quality set separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, in Opus, AAC and MP3 tiers, or send the original file untouched
- Internet radio

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY

- Multi-library Navidrome support: All Libraries, a single library, or any subset, filtered on the server
- Star ratings synced to your server
- Classical music: automatic work and movement grouping
- Optional Last.fm and ListenBrainz integration. Scrobbles route through your own server, never directly from the app.
- Server Health diagnostics: server type, version, OpenSubsonic extensions, scan status

REACHING YOUR SERVER

Built for a locked-down homelab. Custom HTTP headers for Cloudflare Access and Authelia, mTLS client certificates, and access over Tailscale all work, on every platform, with no third-party relay in between.

MULTIPLE LANGUAGES

The app comes in multiple languages, with an in-app language picker on every platform.

REQUIREMENTS

NaviBeat requires a running Navidrome server (v0.50 or later, free and open source) accessible from your Apple device. Self-host it on a home NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS, or any machine you control. See navibeat.app for setup.

NaviBeat is a third-party client, not affiliated with the Navidrome project.

PRIVACY

NaviBeat collects zero data. There is no NaviBeat backend, no analytics, no telemetry and no third-party SDKs. Your credentials live in your device's Keychain. Your listening history stays on device. See navibeat.app/privacy.

hk.description:
擊敗史萊姆，收集資源，變得更加強大！

這是一款隨著戰鬥不斷進行，攻擊力與火力會無限提升的增量式動作遊戲。擴展技能樹，組合卡牌與遺物，將鋪滿畫面的史萊姆大軍一舉掃蕩！

■ 越戰越強，看得見的成長
擊敗史萊姆以獲取資源和戰利品，並強化角色與武器。
隨著實力不斷累積，起初難以對付的敵人也能在瞬間消滅。體驗增量遊戲的樂趣：變得更強、狩獵更快、獲得更多獎勵。

■ 隨選擇擴展的技能樹
從攻擊力、攻擊速度、特殊能力等方向中，選擇自己想要的成長路線。
優先強化哪些技能，將會改變戰鬥方式與成長速度。按照自己的策略建構技能樹，完成強大的流派。

■ 卡牌與遺物帶來的爆炸火力
組合戰鬥中獲得的卡牌和遺物，即可解鎖新的能力與成長效果。
召喚閃電、釋放會在牆壁之間反彈的迴旋鏢，並使用強力特殊武器掌控戰場。隨著流派逐漸成形，戰鬥也會變得更加華麗、更為強大。

■ 助力成長與戰鬥的傭兵
跨越次元而來的個性傭兵，會以各自獨特的方式追蹤並攻擊敵人。
凍結敵人、召喚隕石，並使用能夠攻擊大範圍區域的傭兵技能。培養並組合傭兵，打造更加高效的戰鬥策略。

■ 不斷變強的武器
武器強化得越多，攻擊範圍和火力就會變得越強。
突破成長極限，以壓倒性的攻擊掃蕩蜂擁而來的史萊姆。不斷累積的成長，將化為爆發力十足的爽快打擊感。

■ 簡單操作，深度成長
體驗任何人都能輕鬆上手的直覺操作，以及豐富多樣的成長系統。
戰鬥方式雖然簡單，但透過組合技能樹、卡牌、遺物、傭兵和武器，可以打造出截然不同的成長策略。

■ 《史萊姆大騷動》的秘密
原本寧靜的米阿勒特峽谷，被一支來歷不明的史萊姆軍團占領了。
獵殺不斷湧來的史萊姆，突破極限並持續成長。你能否找出引發這場巨大騷動的真正幕後黑手，讓峽谷重歸和平？

遊戲特色
- 越戰越強的增量式成長
- 透過收集資源與反覆強化提升火力
- 隨選擇變化的技能樹

- 個性十足的異次元傭兵

- 可持續強化的武器
- 可愛的2D像素畫面
- 鋪滿畫面的史萊姆與爽快打擊感

hk.description:
Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

In this spectacular game of colossal fun, reveal numbers one-by-one and close a corresponding square on one of your cards.
Your goal is to score as many points as possible, and you'll do that mostly by crossing off the nine numbers printed in a 3x3 grid.
Get three-in-a-row to unlock bonuses, which can help you close more squares and trigger even more bonuses.
Use Lightning tokens to nudge numbers to your liking, but don’t forget about Moon tokens to avoid an end-game penalty.
At the end of a round, you score points for each card that you've completely marked off, with the points diminishing each round from 15 in round one to 8 in round four. 
After four rounds, you score 1 point for each two spaces Xed on unfinished cards. Together with your points from completed cards, stars and moons, this determines your total score.

BimmerLink is the direct link to your BMW, MINI, or Toyota Supra. Read and clear trouble codes, monitor live sensor data, and perform maintenance functions from your phone.

A supported OBD adapter or cable is required. Feature availability depends on your vehicle and its equipment.

READ AND CLEAR TROUBLE CODES
Read and clear diagnostic trouble codes from all control units in your car.

LIVE SENSOR DATA
Monitor values such as oil temperature and boost pressure in real time. Create a personalized dashboard to keep the readings that matter to you in view.

DATA LOGGING
Record sensor values in CSV log files for detailed analysis.

CONTROL UNIT FUNCTIONS
Access live data and diagnostic functions for individual control units in your car.

EXHAUST FLAP CONTROL
Choose whether your car's exhaust flap is open or closed. Requires a factory-installed exhaust flap.

ACTIVE SOUND DESIGN
Mute the artificial engine sound generated by Active Sound Design (ASD). Requires factory-installed ASD.

SOUND TUNING
Disable exhaust burble on cars equipped with the S55 engine (M2 Competition, M3, and M4).

DPF REGENERATION
Check the condition of your diesel particulate filter and request a regeneration when needed. Available on supported diesel vehicles equipped with a DPF.

CARPLAY ADD-ON
Use CarPlay to view live sensor data from your car's engine control units and control the exhaust flap and Active Sound Design, all from your car's display. Additional in-app purchase required.

BATTERY REGISTRATION
Register a new battery after replacement directly from the app.

PARKING BRAKE SERVICE MODE
Activate service mode for your car's electromechanical parking brake.

SERVICE RESET
Reset service indicators after completing maintenance, such as an engine oil change or brake pad replacement.

RESET SHORT-CIRCUIT LOCKS
Reset short-circuit locks in the lighting control unit.

TRANSMISSION ADAPTATION VALUES
View adaptation values for your car's ZF 8HP automatic transmission.

REQUIRED ACCESSORIES
BimmerLink requires a supported Bluetooth or Wi-Fi OBD adapter or cable. Visit bimmerlink.app for supported accessories and vehicle information.

Feature availability varies by model and equipment.

hk.description:
Toastie turns your iPhone into a toaster. Work through the orders on the menu, let the chef surprise you, or make your own sandwich from everything in the kitchen.

Make a grilled cheese sandwich from scratch: butter the bread, lay on the cheese and fillings, and put it in the toaster. Close the lid and it starts toasting in real time. Open it too early and the cheese hasn't melted; leave it too long and it burns. Take it out at the right moment and you get a perfect toastie.

HOW IT WORKS
• Butter the bread with your finger: cover the slice, on the right side.
• Drag the cheese and fillings onto the bread and spread them out.
• Hurry: customers are waiting. You have 20 seconds to build each order.
• Press GRILL, close the lid, and wait for the sizzle.
• Open it to check, or trust your timing, then serve.
• Every sandwich gets a score card: recipe, plating, toasting and prep time. Five stars turn it gold.
• Four stars unlock the next recipe.

NEW: CHEF'S CHOICE
A surprise order from 100 new recipes, dealt at random. Make it, shuffle for another, and see how long a streak you can keep going.

NEW: TOAST-OFF
Challenge a friend face to face, on one iPad or an opened iPhone Duo. You both get the same orders: build, grill and serve. After one, three, five or seven rounds, the most stars wins.

NEW: RELAXED MODE
Like to take your time? Switch on Relaxed mode in Settings and play every order without the clock.

MAKE YOUR OWN
No ticket, no clock. Pick a loaf and put on whatever you like, from every ingredient in the kitchen. Grill it, and the cook tells you what worked and what to change. Give your sandwich a name and save it: your saved toasties now sync with iCloud across your devices. Under CUSTOMIZE you pick the plate, the table and the wall, from eight of each.

THE CAFÉ MENU, NOW 25 ORDERS
Ten new orders join the fifteen from cafés around the world. Clear all 25 for awards of their own.

LANDSCAPE ON IPHONE
On iPhone, orders play in landscape, with more room to build and grill. Prefer portrait? Switch back any time in Settings.

THE MENUS
Work through the House Menu, from a Classic Grilled Cheese and Cheese & Tomato to Brie & Cranberry, Mushroom & Taleggio and The Works. Then explore the Café Menu, with a Caprese, a Chicken Pesto Panini, a Kimchi Tuna Melt and a Guacamole Melt. All on white sandwich loaf, sourdough, brioche or ciabatta.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Toastie plays on any iPhone and iPad. On iPhone Duo, the phone itself becomes the toaster: fold it shut to close the lid, and open it to see how your sandwich is doing. Opened, it plays Toast-Off too.

NOW IN SEVEN LANGUAGES
English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

ALSO
• Share a picture of your toastie.
• Your progress syncs with iCloud across your devices.
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements.
• No ads, no in-app purchases. Pay once.

The world's most expensive toaster.

The main screen is rebuilt around what's most relevant: whether a backup is running, how long it will take, and what all your backups have added up to.

Photos and Files backups can now follow your library and folders: items you delete leave the backup too. A Deleted folder keeps them first, for as long as you choose.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
The main screen meets the fold with the status on one half and the controls on the other, and fits the outer screen when closed.

SHORTCUTS AND SIRI, REIMAGINED

• Much improved error reporting.
• New progress sounds. You can turn them off in Settings.
• Many other small improvements and bug fixes.
• Version 2.0.1: Minor fixes and new screenshots.

Version 2.0.2
• New: Option to keep deleted items forever.
• Fixed a crash shortly after starting a backup.
• More reliable mirroring, free space and progress for network share Destinations.

Version 2.0.3
• Drive or network share not connected? Parachute Backup now tells you which destination to connect, in the app, on the Lock Screen and in a notification. The backup continues on its own once it is back.
• Backups started from Shortcuts now wait for a network share that takes a while to reconnect, instead of stopping.

• Stop now ends a backup right away, also while it waits for a download.
• Unchanged items in OneDrive folders with more than 200 items are no longer uploaded again on every backup.
• Items with "%20" in their name now copy to S3 instead of failing with a permission error.
• Network shares: Start Backup in Shortcuts no longer reports an error while the backup waits for the share, and you get one notification instead of two when the wait runs out.

hk.description:
Parachute is your backup companion for iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive. It backs up your memories — photos, videos, and documents — to storage you control, whether that’s an external drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 Buckets, network drives/NAS, external hard drives and more. With Parachute, you get peace of mind and full ownership of your data, free from lock-in.

Your Data, Your Way
	•	Back up your entire iCloud Photos library (including Shared Albums) and folders from iCloud Drive.
	•	Preserve originals in full resolution, all adjustment data, and the current edited versions.
	•	Works with USB drives, NAS/SMB/SFTP mounts, Google Drive, S3 Buckets, OneDrive, external hard drives and more

Key Features
	•	Backups can be triggered from the main screen to any of your backup destinations
	•	Automate backups with Shortcuts integration and Schedules
	•	Privacy-first: transfers handled via Apple’s Files extensions — your credentials never touch our app.
	•	Supports full-quality media: Live Photos + videos, RAW images, bursts, edits, and slow motion.

Why It Matters
	•	iCloud sync ≠ backup — deletions, expired storage, or sync errors can mean permanent loss.
	•	Parachute safeguards your digital life from accidents and disasters.
	•	Your files are stored in normal folders you can browse and restore from directly — no special tools needed.

One time purchase. No Lock-In.
	•	One-time purchase unlocks all backup functionality — no recurring fees.
	•	Your data stays in your storage, not ours.
	•	No accounts, no telemetry, no background bloat.


FAQ Highlights

Q: Does Parachute ever delete files from iCloud?
A: Never. It’s strictly read-only.

Q: Can I restore without Parachute?
A: Yes. Backups are just normal folders — copy them back with Finder anytime.

Q: What if a file is corrupted in iCloud?
A: Parachute flags any unexportable items so you know exactly what couldn’t be saved.

Q: Can it back up non-iCloud folders?
A: Yes. Add any folder via the iOS/iPadOS file picker

By downloading Parachute Backup, you agree to Apple's Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and our Privacy Policy (https://parachuteapps.com/privacy).

HUDDLE UP FOR BACKYARD FOOTBALL

Backyard Football 1999 is now enhanced to run on modern systems. Whether you're picking Jerry Rice or Barry Sanders for your dream team, rushing with Pete Wheeler, scoring touchdowns with Pablo Sanchez, or enjoying the witty banter of hosts Sunny Day and Chuck Downfield, simple controls let anyone pick up and play football!

GAME MODES
Single Game: With 5 backyard fields and unique weather condition settings, players can pick their team, design their team logos, and play a pick-up game!
Season Mode: Players can draft seven players from the 30 iconic Backyard Sports characters and a collection of legendary pros including Barry Sanders, Jerry Rice, John Elway, Dan Marino, Randall Cunningham, Drew Bledsoe and Steve Young to compete against 15 other teams in the Backyard Football League. Each team plays a 14-game season. By the end of the regular season, the 4 division champions and 4 wild card teams enter the Backyard Football League Playoffs to compete for the Super Colossal Cereal Bowl!

EARN CLASSIC POWER UPS
Earn power-ups by completing passes on offense and sacking the opposing QB on defense.

Offensive
• Hocus Pocus – A pass play which results in a receiver teleporting down field.
• Sonic Boom – A run play which causes an earthquake to knock over the opposing team.
• Leap Frog – A run play which causes your running back to leap down field.
• Super Punt – A very powerful punt!

Defensive
• Cough Drop – A play that causes the opponent to fumble when tackled.
• Chameleon – A trick play that results in your team wearing the other team's colors for ultimate confusion.
• Spring Loaded – A play that causes your player to leap over the line of scrimmage to sack the QB.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver.

Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. However, Backyard Football ‘99 runs well, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

STEP UP TO THE PLATE
Relive the second baseball game in the Backyard Sports franchise, now enhanced to run on iOS. Whether you're picking your dream team, playing a pick-up game, or diving into a full season, step up to the plate and experience the game that made baseball fun for everyone!

Backyard Baseball ‘01 teams up the Backyard kids with Backyardified MLB legends. Create your own Backyard team, customize your uniforms, and strategize to win the Championship. Play a single pick-up game or play through an entire season. Backyard Baseball ‘01 features intuitive controls for all ages!

SWING BACK INTO BASEBALL
Enjoy baseball like it’s 2001!
30 Charming Backyard kids
Legendary MLB Players
MLB Team Marks
Hilarious Bloopers
8 Classic Ballparks
9 Pitching Power-ups and 4 batting Power-ups
Lively commentary from Sunny Day and Vinnie

To get into the swing of things, choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit the ball!

THE GOAT RETURNS
Play with the legend himself, Pablo Sanchez. Build a roster from a cast of 30 hilarious child athletes and 28 legendary pros that made Backyard Baseball ‘01 a sports classic. Returning MLB players include Derek Jeter, Alex Rodriguez, Cal Ripken Jr., Sammy Sosa, Mike Piazza, Randy Johnson, Nomar Garciaparra, Jeff Bagwell, Jason Giambi, Chipper Jones, Jeromy Burnitz, Mark McGwire, Shawn Green, Vladimir Guerrero, Kenny Lofton, Jason Kendall, Barry Larkin, Marty Cordova, Mo Vaughn, Raul Mondesi, Curt Schilling, Alex Gonzalez, Juan Gonzalez, Larry Walker, Carlos Beltran, Tony Gwynn, Ivan Rodriguez, and Jose Canseco.

Game Modes include:
Choose from three modes of play (Easy Mode, Medium Mode, Hard Mode)
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer choosing players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You pick your home field, create a team, and manage the team through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At the end of the season, the best two teams advance to the BBL playoffs (best of 3). ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver.

Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. As an example, we can’t use the original 32bit code to support modern macOS, as even with an incredibly clever wrapper, macOS can’t execute the binaries.

Backyard Baseball ‘01 runs well, looks better than ever, includes new bonus features to test your mettle, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

hk.description:
Solo is the ultimate practice App for mastering fretboard visualization, designed by world renowned guitarists Tom Quayle and David Beebee.

Four powerful fretboard trainers allow you to work intuitively on each aspect of the visualization process; learning note names, memorising interval shapes, outlining chord changes, and practicing scales.

Solo asks you to find intervallic functions against one root note, chord symbol or scale at a time, listens to the notes you play, and doesn’t move on until you’ve correctly found each note by its intervallic function in the specified order.

Practice with Solo and finally learn your note names, master interval shapes, confidently play through chord changes and break out of scale boxes with intervallic functions. Start transforming your playing and confidence on the fretboard today!


NOTE TRAINER
The Note Trainer is perfect for beginner and intermediate players getting to grips with note names on the neck - the foundation of solid fretboard knowledge. 

‣ Solo shows you random root notes to find and listens, waiting for you to get it correct.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Optional practice suggestions offer challenging ways to limit and test yourself.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


INTERVAL TRAINER
The Interval Trainer will help players at all levels work on interval shapes with intervallic functions - the key to unlocking true freedom on the fretboard.

‣ Choose any combination of intervallic functions to practice.
‣ Create custom interval groups or choose the intervals for ANY chord type or scale.
‣ The Interval Trainer will randomise your chosen intervals and ask you to find them against either a fixed or random root note.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams, showing you where all of the interval shapes are across the neck, and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


CHANGES TRAINER
In the Changes Trainer you find intervallic functions, using single notes to outline different chord types or sets of chord changes, a key skill for learning to improvise through chord changes.  

‣ Practice outlining intervallic functions through over 100 common chord progressions and single chord exercises.
‣ 50 intervallic function levels. Go from simple chord tones to complex melodic structures and scales. 
‣ Solo intelligently maps out the correct intervals over each chord and listens for you to play each intervallic function in the specified order.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Transpose the key of any progression or exercise. 
‣ Choose to randomly transpose the progression (or single chord exercise) each time it repeats.
‣ Work on voice leading chord tones through single note lines.


SCALE TRAINER
The Scale Trainer contains a vast array of scales and powerful workout options, allowing you to finally break out of the box and develop a much deeper understanding of how scales are constructed on the fretboard.

‣ Practice finding scales on the fretboard using intervallic functions. 
‣ Over 50+ Scales and modes.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Melodic sequence options let you focus on starting from any chord tone within the scale.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.

• Access the entire Apple Music catalog of over 100 million songs!

ADJUST THE TEMPO

CREATE SETLISTS

REPEAT JUST ONE SECTION

APPLE WATCH

AIRPLAY

AND MORE..

hk.description:
LumaFusion: 影片編輯的終極敘事體驗

歡迎體驗 App Store 2021「年度最佳 App」及「編輯精選獎」的得獎 App！我們是世界各地故事創作者的專業標準，提供流暢直觀、為觸控螢幕而設計的剪輯體驗。

【專業剪輯從此簡單又輕鬆】
• 6 條影音軌 / 圖像軌道：建立多層編輯，並平滑處理 4K ProRes 和 HDR 媒體。
• 另外 6 條音軌：建立聲景。
• 終極時間軸體驗：使用全球最靈活的軌道及磁性時間軸，實現流暢編輯。
• 大量過場效果：讓您的故事持續推進。
• 在外接顯示器上顯示預覽：在大螢幕上查看。
• 加入標記、標籤和備註：計畫案保持井井有條。
• 加入旁白：在播放您的電影的同時錄製旁白。

【圖層效果、色彩校正】
• 綠幕、亮度與色度去背：運用創意來建立圖層合成。
• Lock and Load 穩定器：保持鏡頭穩定。
• 強大的色彩校正：打造您自己的風格。
• 視頻波形、向量和直方圖範圍。
• LUT 色彩檔：匯入並套用多個 .cube 或 .3dl LUT 色彩檔。
• 關鍵影格無限數量：精準製作動畫效果。
• 自訂文字和效果預設值：儲存並分享你喜歡的動畫效果和外觀。
• 網格和參考線：精確對齊元素與標題安全區域、動作安全區域和水平線。

【進階音訊控制】
• 使用圖示型等化器、參數型等化器、聲音隔離功能：完美調整音訊細節。
• 關鍵影格音訊電平、聲像、等化器：進行完美混音。
• 支援立體聲和雙單聲道音訊：適用於在單一片段中使用多個麥克風的訪談。
• 使用自動迴避：在話語期間迴避音樂，保持音訊平衡。
• 第三方音訊擴充程式：增強聲音效果。

【創意標題字幕、多層文字】
• 建立多層標題字幕：將圖形、圖像和文字加入您的圖形中。
• 自行調整字體、顏色、填充顏色、邊框和陰影：設計出引人注目的標題字幕。
• 匯入自訂字體：增強您的品牌。
• 儲存並分享標題字幕預設值：非常適合協作。

【計畫案彈性管理、媒體素材庫】
• 涵蓋所有不同需求的長寬比：包括寬銀幕電影、社群媒體影片或更多其他需求。
• 影格率範圍為 18fps-240fps：可靈活應用於任何工作流程。
• 直接編輯來自 USB-C 硬碟、「照片」App 和 Frame.io 的媒體項目：讓你隨時隨地存取媒體內容。
• 從雲端匯入媒體：自選儲存空間，沒有限制。

【分享剪輯成果】
• 控制解析度、畫質和格式：
• 將電影分享至社交媒體、本地儲存或雲端儲存。
• 跨裝置剪輯：輕鬆無縫傳輸計畫案。

增強功能（可單獨購買，或作為創作者通行證訂閱的一部分獲取所有功能 - 請參見下文）
• 速度調節與增強關鍵幀 - 使用這個獨一無二且易於使用的功能，創建速度調節、貝茲曲線和緩動效果。
• XML 匯出：將你的計畫案匯出到 Mac 上的 Final Cut Pro
• Multicam Studio「多機工作室」：同步 6 個攝影機或音訊，點一下即可切換角度

創作者通行證訂閱
• 享用 Storyblocks for LumaFusion：數百萬首高品質免版稅音樂、音效和視頻，還可獲得上述所有增強功能。

hk.description:
Just Press Record 是終極錄音程式，只需一鍵即可錄音、轉寫並透過 iCloud 在所有裝置上同步。 你可以編輯音訊並且直接在程式內轉寫文本，還可透過 Siri 直接開始錄製新內容！

生活充滿了我們不願忘記的時刻——比如你的孩子說的第一句話、一次重要的會議、一次靈光乍現。 在 iPhone、iPad、Mac 以及 Apple Watch 上便捷的記錄這些瞬間。

錄音
• 一鍵即可開始、停止、暫停、繼續錄音。
• 透過捷徑、Siri、小工具、3D Touch 的「快速動作」或 URL 架構來開始和停止錄音。
• 錄音時間無限制。
• 在後台仍可錄音。
• 可選擇錄音源為內置麥克風、AirPods 或外置麥克風。
• 在 Apple Watch 上獨立錄音並可之後再同步。

播放
• 在播放過程中向後和向前快速查找。
• 播放速度可調節。

轉寫
• 將語音辨識為可搜尋的文字。
• 支援超過 30 種語言，與您裝置的語言設定無關。
• 同步文字高亮和音訊播放。
• 在錄音時可以識別標點符號口令。

編輯
• 音訊 - 以波形視圖顯示音訊，讓你可以去掉不需要的部分。
• 文本 - 對轉寫文本內容進行修改和添加。

分享
• 將音訊和文本分享到其他應用程式。
• 作為影片剪輯簡單分享到社群媒體。
• 透過 USB 連接線分享到 Mac 或 PC 上的 iTunes。
• 列印轉寫文本。
• 在其他應用程式中將音訊檔案分享到 Just Press Record。 

管理
• 檢視最近的錄音或按照日期時間瀏覽音訊庫。
• 按檔案名或轉寫內容搜尋。
• 用於快速訪問 Apple Watch 錄音的專用介面。
• 重命名錄音。
• 支援 iPad 的 Slide Over 和 Split View 功能。
• 在應用程式圖示上添加了顯示未播放錄音的數目。

儲存空間
• 選擇將錄音儲存在 iCloud Drive 或裝置本地。
• 儲存在 iCloud Drive 的錄音將自動在所有裝置間同步。
• 錄音通過「檔案」程式整合和自動 iTunes 檔案分享存儲在本地。
• 轉寫內容與音訊檔共同儲存。

專業音訊
• 在支援的裝置上通過內建麥克風進行立體聲錄音。
• 支援透過 Lightning Port 連接的高品質外置麥克風。
• 自訂音訊設定以增強您的錄音體驗。
• 檔案類型包括 WAV、AIF 及標準 iTunes M4A (ACC)。
• 音訊品質最高可達 96kHz / 24-bit。

輔助使用
• 程式完全支援 VoiceOver 功能。
• 開始/停止錄音支持智慧手勢操作。

Apple Watch
Just Press Record 包含一款 Apple Watch 程式，讓你隨時隨地，即使 iPhone 不在身邊，也可以自由錄音。

• 在複雜功能上輕點即可開始錄音。
• 在後台仍可錄音。
• 錄音時間無限制。
• 錄音自動傳輸到 iPhone 進行轉寫並同步到 iCloud。
• 透過內置喇叭或 AirPods 聆聽最近的錄音。
• 透過 Digital Crown 調節音量。
• 向下滑動即可暫停錄音。
• 支援 VoiceOver 輔助使用，降低動作幅度，支援超大複雜功能模版。

重要事項:
• Just Press Record 不會錄製電話通話內容和來自其他應用程式的音訊。
• 轉寫功能僅對高品質、低噪音的音訊內容有效。  避免錄音環境過於嘈雜，將麥克風儘量靠近說話人。
• 您可以在我們的常見問題頁面上瞭解 Just Press Record 的 URL 架構。

hk.description:
Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997! Build your roster from the iconic cast of 30 characters stacked with charming personalities and witty banter, and get the edge on the competition with power-ups, fireball pitches, super strength, and Pablo Sanchez!
Play pick-up games, practice batting, and compete in single games or a whole season with simple, intuitive controls that anyone can master!
Game Modes:
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself, and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer to choose players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You create a team and manage it through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At the end of the season the best two teams advance to the BBL playoffs (best of 3). The winner advances to the championship series which consists of the Super Entire Nation Tournament (best of 3) and then the Ultra Grand Championship of the Universe Series (best of 5)!
Batting Practice: Choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit that ball!
T-ball - Select T-ball mode for more accessible game play. Simply click to hit, run, and field!
 
BACKYARD BASEBALL RULES
The rules for Backyard Baseball are a hybrid of Pro and Little League rules:
No leading off
No Injuries
Bunting is allowed
Tagging up is allowed
Stealing is allowed
 
At our core, we are fans first–not just of video games but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. Backyard Baseball '97 runs buttery smooth for iOS devices, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the title that started it all.
