Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier.

Create professional Jazz Fusion to your own choice of chords in minutes. Everything you need to create and share thousands of stunning royalty-free tracks.

Hear the results. Watch the video at sessionbandapp.com

The fastest way to create your own studio-quality music:

BACKYARD BASEBALL RULES
The rules for Backyard Baseball are a hybrid of Pro and Little League rules:
No leading off
No Injuries
Bunting is allowed
Tagging up is allowed
Stealing is allowed
 
At our core, we are fans first–not just of video games but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. Backyard Baseball '97 runs buttery smooth for iOS devices, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the title that started it all.

us.description:
Nautilus is a web browser built for research. Read the web, mark it up, ask AI about what you find, and write up your work without leaving the app, on iPad and iPhone.

Students, researchers, journalists, writers and professionals use it to go from first search to finished document in one place.

Browse with research tools built in
Open pages in tabs, pin the ones you come back to, and keep sites in bookmarks and history. Switch to Reader for a clean page without distractions, or let Reader turn on automatically. Request the desktop version of a site when you need it.

Understand any page
Ask AI about the page you're reading. Summarize a long article, or translate a page into your language or into English, then switch back to the original at any time.

Circle it with Magic Lasso
Circle a passage, chart or image on a page. Ask AI to explain it, ask your own question, highlight it, or save it as a clip on your Clippings board so your findings stay together.

Mark up the web
Draw and write directly on web pages. Export a page with your markup as a PDF in A4, Letter or Legal size, or as a Word document, Markdown, RTF, plain text or an image.

Read and annotate your sources
Open PDFs, papers and reports in tabs beside your web pages. Highlight, write in the margins, add comments, and compare two documents side by side. Fill and sign forms, scan paper pages into PDFs, measure scaled drawings, and hide sensitive text before you share.

Write it up
Draft in Word documents, RTF, Markdown or plain text. Plan a long paper or book section by section on a Corkboard, keep your sources open next to the draft, take snapshots of earlier versions, and compile everything into one document or ebook. Study Projects gather the readings for each subject in one place.

AI help from first idea to final draft
Chat through ideas, ask about your own documents, and get explanations. Rewrite, simplify, correct spelling and grammar, change the tone, or translate what you've written.

Also in Nautilus
Record lectures and interviews and create transcripts. Connect ideas on whiteboards with sticky notes, organize plans in outlines, and work through calculations and charts in Math Notebooks.

Your library, safe and in sync
Keep documents in folders and notebooks with covers, and find anything with search. Export to PDF, Word, HTML, EPUB and more. Sync with iCloud, Dropbox, Box, Google Drive or WebDAV. Automatic saving, recovery and backups protect your work, and passcodes lock the app or private folders.

《孙美琪疑案》是一款第一人称 3D 沉浸式硬核探案推理游戏。你将化身刑警刘青春，从第一季《孙美琪》出发，沿着《方婷婷》《王思凤》《王爱国》《杜翠兰》一路深入至第五季终章，孤身踏入上世纪九十年代的老旧居民楼、精神病院、深夜小学、废弃工厂、国际列车、古墓密室与异乡公寓，在极具年代感与压迫感的真实案发现场中搜集隐藏线索，通过“线索关联”层层抽丝剥茧，还原每一桩离奇案件背后令人脊背发凉的真相。

• 第 1～5 季、全 30 集一站式收录：完整囊括系列第 1 季至第 5 季全部 30 部独立案件，一集一个独立故事，五季暗线草蛇灰线、环环相扣，老玩家重温与新玩家入坑一步到位。

• 贴心探案辅助：提供「线索扫描」与脑图「一键关联」辅助功能，卡关时助你快速找回推理思路，既保留硬核解谜成就感，也不再为找不到微小物件而苦恼。

tr.description:
Sorapuff is a gentle flight buddy for nervous flyers. Before you board it shows where the bumps are likely on your route; in the air it explains every bump, offline, with Sora by your side.

BEFORE YOU FLY
• A turbulence forecast for your route, made on your iPhone from free public weather data (NOAA)
• Smooth, light or moderate, stretch by stretch, in plain words: "likely smooth for the first two hours"
• Storm warnings (SIGMETs) and recent pilot reports along the way
• A route map with every bumpy stretch, storm and pilot report (Pro)
• Reminders: when the forecast is ready, to save it before airplane mode, and at boarding

IN THE AIR, IN AIRPLANE MODE
• A big flight tracker: where you are, how long to go, and what's next
• A calm bump meter that measures each bump and tells you how small it really was. The wing is built for 2.5 g
• Sora's tips for every phase, from taxi to landing
• A heads-up 10 minutes before a bumpy stretch, so nothing surprises you

WHEN IT FEELS LIKE TOO MUCH
• One tap on Calm: breathe with Sora, feel each breath as a soft, slow haptic, and ground yourself step by step
• Optional calming music, made live on your iPhone
• Works from the Home Screen, Siri, Shortcuts, the Action button and Control Center

AFTER YOU LAND
• Your Bump Report: every bump, in words, and a pretty card to share ("I flew!")
• Collect Sky Cards for every brave moment and dress Sora in new outfits

FLYERS HELPING FLYERS
• After you land, send that flight's bumps with one tap: anonymous, just two airport codes, the hour and the bumps
• Every shared flight checks the forecast against real bumps, and helps make it better for the next nervous flyer

FIND YOUR FLIGHTS, PRIVATELY
• Paste your booking email, open the PDF or scan your boarding pass
• Or let Sorapuff look for bookings in your calendar or, if you choose, search your email read-only, on your iPhone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Your flights stay on your iPhone

PAY ONCE
Sorapuff is free to download with the bump meter, tracker, Calm, breathing and your first route forecast. Sorapuff Pro is one purchase, no subscription: unlimited forecasts up to 3 days ahead, the route map, every Sky Card and outfit, all music moods, the widget and the Live Activity. Family Sharing included.

Sorapuff gives information and calming tools. It isn't medical advice: always follow your crew.

tr.description:
Comic Weather is a weather app for iPhone that turns your forecast into a comic book page. The sky over you is painted as the opening panel, a narrator sums up the day in a yellow caption box, and the hours and days ahead follow in panels below.

Under the ink is a real forecast from Apple Weather, from the next hour of rain to 10 days ahead.

FOUR COMIC SKINS
• Four-Color: the newsstand look. Ben-Day dots, primary colors, heavy black ink.
• Bubblegum Bloom: pastel pop. Bubblegum pink, mint and lilac, blossoms and sparkles.
• Megacity Manga: dense manga ink over a towering city.
• Midnight City: gothic noir. Near-black pages, amber lamplight, spires in the rain.
A skin reprints the whole app: icons, widgets and the app icon.

192 PAINTED SCENES
Twelve kinds of weather are each painted for dawn, day, dusk and night, in all four skins. Every scene moves: rain sheets down, fog rolls in, lamps flicker, lightning cracks.

RAIN, ON THE CLOCK
Where Apple Weather has minute-by-minute data, a panel charts the next hour: "Rain starts in 12 min." Tap Follow on Lock Screen and the countdown moves to your Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island, or let it start by itself for your main place.

SUNSET FORECAST
Sky on fire, or a fizzle? A new panel grades the next sunset from Fizzle to Epic, with a score out of 100, the sunset time, and when golden hour starts and the blue hour ends. It reads the low, mid and high cloud and says why: "High clouds to catch the color." A forecast, not a promise.

EVERY SKIN HAS A VOICE
Each skin has its own narrator for captions and notifications. Swap anytime:
• Four-Color, Dramatic: "Fog swallows the city whole."
• Bubblegum Bloom, Chipper: "Fog! The city is playing hide and seek."
• Megacity Manga, Hyped: "Foggy. The map hasn't loaded yet."
• Midnight City, Deadpan: "Fog. The world is on low resolution."

THE FORECAST, PANEL BY PANEL
• Current conditions, feels-like temperature and today's high and low
• Right now: wind and gusts, humidity, UV, pressure, visibility, sunrise and sunset
• The next 24 hours, hour by hour, with the chance of rain
• A 10-day forecast. Tap any day for rain totals, wind, UV, sunrise, sunset and moon phase
• Severe weather alerts from official agencies, where available
• Save places and swipe between them
• Your units: °C or °F, and wind down to knots or Beaufort

NOTIFICATIONS ONLY WHEN THE FORECAST CALLS FOR THEM
• A morning briefing at the time you choose
• Rain alerts before it starts and before it stops
• Evening planning tips: "Tomorrow's sunny — make a plan"
• Severe weather alerts, and a heads-up when tomorrow brings heat or frost
• Sunset alerts about an hour ahead, when tonight looks Vivid or Epic
Your iPhone works them out from the forecast it has. Switch each kind on or off.

WIDGETS, SIRI AND CONTROL CENTER
• Comic Page (large), Comic Strip (medium) and Comic Panel (small)
• Weather Glyph for the Lock Screen
• Ask Siri "Will it rain, Comic Weather?" or use Shortcuts
• Weather Now: the temperature as a Control Center button

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
Every screen, caption and widget speaks 26 languages, from Español to हिन्दी and 日本語.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your approximate location, rounded to about 100 meters, goes straight to the weather service. There is no Comic Weather server.

BUILT FOR VOICEOVER AND LARGE TEXT
VoiceOver reads every panel, and "Read plainly" gives you the forecast without the jokes. Text scales up to the largest accessibility sizes.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PRICE FOR FULL
Free with Four-Color, the 10-day forecast, rain alerts and a small widget. Try everything 7 days free, then unlock Full once: every skin and narrator, the Sunset forecast, all widgets, the rain countdown. No subscription, no ads. Already bought it? Everything stays yours.

Weather data from Apple Weather, with MET Norway as a backup. Apple Weather is a trademark of Apple Inc.

Questions or ideas: support@comicweather.app

• The cursor turns into a hand over links and buttons (Settings › Trackpad & Cursor › Pointing Hand). The TV's address bar has a fullscreen button, on unless turned off in Settings › External Monitor › Fullscreen Button on the TV.
• The address you're editing on the iPad or iPhone shows on the TV as in a text field: the selection highlighted, or a blinking cursor. With the mouse on the TV, click to put the cursor there, drag to select, double-click to select a word.
• The shield on the TV's address bar: turn the pop-up blocker off for the site on screen when a page doesn't work right, or for every site, turn Block All Pop-ups on or off, and see how many pop-ups were stopped on the page. The shield in the address bar on the iPad or iPhone has the same switches.

tr.description:
Grounds Up is a single-player business tycoon game for iPhone. You open your first small café on a busy street. Each week you set prices, pay your people, pick your coffee and read the results. Then the company grows far beyond coffee: more cafés in more cities, hotels, an AI lab and a fund of your own.

Time moves only when you tap the date, one week at a time. There is no timer and no game over. Everything in the game is made up: the companies, the people, the banks and the money. It is a game, not a financial service, and nothing in it is financial advice.

A GROUP THAT KEEPS GROWING
• Build cafés in eight cities: Osaka, Tokyo, New York, Chicago, London, Paris, Berlin and São Paulo.
• Choose the look, the machines, the menu and the prices of every café, and hire managers to run them.
• Open hotels. Pick the class, the rooms and the rates, and read the guest reviews.
• Start an AI lab and grow it through research, products and funding rounds.
• Run a fund with outside investors and a record that sets the size of the next one.
• Lease offices, buy property, and buy and name landmarks.

STAKES, BOARDS AND VOTES
• Buy shares in listed companies and back startups through their funding rounds.
• Build a stake big enough for a seat on the board, then more seats, then the chair.
• Sit in board meetings. Read the facts, weigh the options and vote, or let your seats vote for you.
• Win control of a company and merge it into your group.

RIVALS AND RECORDS
• 300 rival tycoons grow their own fortunes while you build yours.
• Climb the rich list and chase records, from your first billion up.
• Play Relaxed, Normal, Hard or Tycoon, with up to five rival companies.

PAY ONCE, NOTHING ELSE TO BUY
• One payment on the App Store.
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscription.
• Works offline. The game never needs the internet.
• No account. No tracking. Keep up to ten games on your phone.

All companies, people and money in the game are made up. Nothing here is financial advice.

tr.description:
Pay-per-book: Your first notebook with unlimited pages is included with your initial purchase, and you can add up to four more books for a one-time fee of $1.99 each. All features included, forever. No subscriptions, ever. That is a promise. 

TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook into the digital world, with smart tools to find your notes whenever you need them and endless ways to make it yours. All topped off with stunning cover art options made by real humans and endless ways to personalise your notebook.

No account required. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Opens to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. To enter swipe the book cover or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget. 

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Link Notes, add photos, PDFs, timestamps, checklists, titles, bullet points and more to your notes. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way around.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout. 

- Make it yours! Pick lined, grid, blank or dotted paper and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts, choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts or even upload your own. And if that’s not enough, turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour for all pages or just one specific page, and go wild. Ooh, and wait until you’ve seen our gorgeous Dark Mode.

- Choose from beautiful cover artworks from our own TypeDraw collection or explore premium art from illustrators like Gabor Estefan and make your notebook something truly satisfying to look at every time you open it. Take that, generative AI!

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too, and you can reorder them with a simple drag and drop.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

tr.description:
NaviBeat brings your own music library to every Apple device you own: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch, plus CarPlay, as a single Universal Purchase. Pay once.

No subscriptions. No ads. No tracking. No NaviBeat cloud. Your music stays on your own server, exactly where you put it. NaviBeat just plays it, beautifully.

ABOUT NAVIDROME

NaviBeat is a client for Navidrome, the free and open-source self-hosted music server. Run Navidrome on a NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS or any machine you control, and NaviBeat streams your collection to every Apple device. Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic and any OpenSubsonic server work too.

ON iPHONE & iPAD
- Browse artists, albums, playlists and genres
- Voice and text search with live results
- Now Playing with synced lyrics
- Background audio, Control Center, AirPlay, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets
- Offline: keep a song, an album, a playlist or a whole artist on the device
- Listening Stats: a 24-hour clock, a weekday heatmap, your top artists and songs
- Smart Playlists you write yourself, from rating, genre, year, play count and more, kept current and synced across your devices
- Start on one device and carry on with another. The device you left pauses itself

IN THE CAR

- Full CarPlay support, included in the same purchase
- Your library, playlists, downloads and Now Playing on the car screen
- Voice search that resolves the play command against your own library, not a streaming catalogue, in every language the app ships

ON MAC

- A real Mac app, not a phone app in a window
- A Mini Player that pins over any window
- Keyboard shortcuts, multi-window and directory browsing, desktop widgets
- NaviSyncRock: sync your library to a Rockbox player. Your server does the transcoding, art is re-encoded so it renders, and plays sync back. A separate one-time in-app unlock.

ON APPLE TV

- Cinema-scale artwork and discovery shelves
- Recently Played, Most Played, Rediscover, On This Day, Because You Listened To
- Voice search via the Siri Remote
- Full-screen Now Playing with synced lyrics

ON APPLE WATCH

- Now Playing complications on any watch face
- Music stored on the watch and played from it, so you can run without your iPhone
- Downloads pulled straight from your server over Wi-Fi

AUDIO

- Selectable high-fidelity playback engine
- 10-band equalizer with presets
- ReplayGain volume normalisation, per track or per album
- Gapless playback
- Streaming quality set separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, in Opus, AAC and MP3 tiers, or send the original file untouched
- Internet radio

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY

- Multi-library Navidrome support: All Libraries, a single library, or any subset, filtered on the server
- Star ratings synced to your server
- Classical music: automatic work and movement grouping
- Optional Last.fm and ListenBrainz integration. Scrobbles route through your own server, never directly from the app.
- Server Health diagnostics: server type, version, OpenSubsonic extensions, scan status

REACHING YOUR SERVER

Built for a locked-down homelab. Custom HTTP headers for Cloudflare Access and Authelia, mTLS client certificates, and access over Tailscale all work, on every platform, with no third-party relay in between.

MULTIPLE LANGUAGES

The app comes in multiple languages, with an in-app language picker on every platform.

REQUIREMENTS

NaviBeat requires a running Navidrome server (v0.50 or later, free and open source) accessible from your Apple device. Self-host it on a home NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS, or any machine you control. See navibeat.app for setup.

NaviBeat is a third-party client, not affiliated with the Navidrome project.

PRIVACY

NaviBeat collects zero data. There is no NaviBeat backend, no analytics, no telemetry and no third-party SDKs. Your credentials live in your device's Keychain. Your listening history stays on device. See navibeat.app/privacy.

tr.description:
Play chapters 1–10 free. One purchase unlocks all 40 chapters.

In the arsenal of the old kingdom of Veyrholm, hungry weapons lay sleeping. They ate the souls of the king and his people, until the Nine Wardens bound them in chains and sealed them away. The game begins on the day the first seal breaks.

You are one of those weapons. Attacks are automatic: move with the joystick on the left and use your movement skill with the button on the right. Each enemy you cut down fills your Hunger a little. When Hunger runs out, the weapon falls asleep and the run is over. Spend the Souls you gather in a run to inscribe Shards in the Growth Tree, and you wake up that much stronger in the next run.

On each level-up you pick 1 of 3 Curse Cards. If you max out an Attack card while holding its paired Support card, it evolves. Relics dropped by Elites change the rules of the run instead of your stats.

- 6 weapons: the Cursed Sword, Axe, Bow, Staff, Twin Blades and Spear. Each has its own basic attack and movement skill (Dash, Leap, Roll, Blink, Gale), and defeating the boss of certain chapters for the first time wakes new weapons.
- 8 areas and 40 chapters. There are four difficulties (Novice, Easy, Normal and Hard), and in the full game, clearing Chapter 5 opens Endless Mode.
- Four chapters in the first area each have their own look: a candlelit ossuary, a sewer crypt with flowing water, a violet bone sanctuary and an underground chapel lit by moonlight and stained glass.
- 8 Wardens, 8 Elite captains and 8 stronger Midbosses each fight with their own attacks. Every attack is telegraphed first.
- 19 Attack cards, 23 Support cards, 22 evolutions, 21 Relics and 7 Familiars.
- The Growth Tree is an upright sword with four branches and 159 Shards.
- The Forge has 5 Part slots, and Honing with Honing Stones never fails and goes up to +20. You get an extra bonus at +5, +10, +15 and +20.
- Looks: restyle the 7 parts of each weapon, with 6,434 designs across all 6 weapons. There are 90 Sets you can equip all at once, including Sets from the Joseon, Christmas, Biscuit sticks, Snack bar and Bathhouse editions. They unlock as you clear chapters and defeat enemies, and none of them are sold for money.
- After the ending, 10 Curse Tiers open up. There are also per-weapon Records and Today's bounty.
- During a run you also run into a fleeing Treasure wraith, a Cursed altar that brings out Elites, and a Mimic pretending to be a chest.
- Chapters 1–10 (the ossuary and the monastery, with the Sword and Axe) are free. Buy 'Unlock full game' once to open all 40 chapters, all 6 weapons, the ending and Curse Tiers, keeping your progress. If you already bought the game, everything stays unlocked. No ads and no loot boxes. Your progress is saved on your device.
- Available in Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish and German.

Also from the same developer: Sasinpae, a card roguelike where you play cards against dokkaebi from Korean folk tales.

tr.description:
Toastie turns your iPhone into a toaster. Work through the orders on the menu, let the chef surprise you, or make your own sandwich from everything in the kitchen.

Make a grilled cheese sandwich from scratch: butter the bread, lay on the cheese and fillings, and put it in the toaster. Close the lid and it starts toasting in real time. Open it too early and the cheese hasn't melted; leave it too long and it burns. Take it out at the right moment and you get a perfect toastie.

HOW IT WORKS
• Butter the bread with your finger: cover the slice, on the right side.
• Drag the cheese and fillings onto the bread and spread them out.
• Hurry: customers are waiting. You have 20 seconds to build each order.
• Press GRILL, close the lid, and wait for the sizzle.
• Open it to check, or trust your timing, then serve.
• Every sandwich gets a score card: recipe, plating, toasting and prep time. Five stars turn it gold.
• Four stars unlock the next recipe.

NEW: CHEF'S CHOICE
A surprise order from 100 new recipes, dealt at random. Make it, shuffle for another, and see how long a streak you can keep going.

NEW: TOAST-OFF
Challenge a friend face to face, on one iPad or an opened iPhone Duo. You both get the same orders: build, grill and serve. After one, three, five or seven rounds, the most stars wins.

NEW: RELAXED MODE
Like to take your time? Switch on Relaxed mode in Settings and play every order without the clock.

MAKE YOUR OWN
No ticket, no clock. Pick a loaf and put on whatever you like, from every ingredient in the kitchen. Grill it, and the cook tells you what worked and what to change. Give your sandwich a name and save it: your saved toasties now sync with iCloud across your devices. Under CUSTOMIZE you pick the plate, the table and the wall, from eight of each.

THE CAFÉ MENU, NOW 25 ORDERS
Ten new orders join the fifteen from cafés around the world. Clear all 25 for awards of their own.

LANDSCAPE ON IPHONE
On iPhone, orders play in landscape, with more room to build and grill. Prefer portrait? Switch back any time in Settings.

THE MENUS
Work through the House Menu, from a Classic Grilled Cheese and Cheese & Tomato to Brie & Cranberry, Mushroom & Taleggio and The Works. Then explore the Café Menu, with a Caprese, a Chicken Pesto Panini, a Kimchi Tuna Melt and a Guacamole Melt. All on white sandwich loaf, sourdough, brioche or ciabatta.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Toastie plays on any iPhone and iPad. On iPhone Duo, the phone itself becomes the toaster: fold it shut to close the lid, and open it to see how your sandwich is doing. Opened, it plays Toast-Off too.

NOW IN SEVEN LANGUAGES
English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

ALSO
• Share a picture of your toastie.
• Your progress syncs with iCloud across your devices.
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements.
• No ads, no in-app purchases. Pay once.

The world's most expensive toaster.

YOUR BACKUPS AT A GLANCE
The main screen is rebuilt around what's most relevant: whether a backup is running, how long it will take, and what all your backups have added up to.

MIRRORING
Photos and Files backups can now follow your library and folders: items you delete leave the backup too. A Deleted folder keeps them first, for as long as you choose.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
The main screen meets the fold with the status on one half and the controls on the other, and fits the outer screen when closed.

SHORTCUTS AND SIRI, REIMAGINED
A new Start Backup action replaces Start Photo Backup and Start File Backup, joined by actions to stop a backup and ask how it is going. Your existing shortcuts keep working.
 ALSO IN THIS UPDATE
• The Live Activity has been redesigned.
• Much improved error reporting.
• New progress sounds. You can turn them off in Settings.
• Many other small improvements and bug fixes.
• Version 2.0.1: Minor fixes and new screenshots.

Version 2.0.2
• New: Option to keep deleted items forever.
• Fixed a crash shortly after starting a backup.
• More reliable mirroring, free space and progress for network share Destinations.

Version 2.0.3
• Drive or network share not connected? Parachute Backup now tells you which destination to connect, in the app, on the Lock Screen and in a notification. The backup continues on its own once it is back.
• Backups started from Shortcuts now wait for a network share that takes a while to reconnect, instead of stopping.
• When your cloud storage asks you to sign in again, the backup stops right away instead of waiting for hours. Sign in from the main screen and the backup runs again.
• The Keep Items duration for mirrored Files backups no longer snaps back to 90 Days.
• Photos Settings on iPhone now shows your changes right away.
• The Destination row shows drive or share and folder, like "NAS ▸ Backups".
• Fixed random characters in front of some network share names.

Version 2.0.4
• When a download from iCloud stalls, a countdown now shows how long Parachute Backup waits for it.
• Stop now ends a backup right away, also while it waits for a download.
• Unchanged items in OneDrive folders with more than 200 items are no longer uploaded again on every backup.
• Items with "%20" in their name now copy to S3 instead of failing with a permission error.
• Network shares: Start Backup in Shortcuts no longer reports an error while the backup waits for the share, and you get one notification instead of two when the wait runs out.
• A document that a network share refused to replace is no longer reported as a Photos library that is not included.

Version 2.0.5
• Fixes a blank screen on iPadOS 27.3 beta.
• Some NAS models do not provide a folder listing to iPhone and iPad. Parachute Backup now detects that situation, keeps backing up, and tells you why deletions cannot be mirrored.
• Before you add a folder on a NAS as a Destination, Parachute Backup now checks it for known problems and tells you about them.
• When a photo or video fails to copy, you now see whether it comes from the Photo Library or from a shared album, and which album.

tr.description:
Parachute is your backup companion for iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive. It backs up your memories — photos, videos, and documents — to storage you control, whether that’s an external drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 Buckets, network drives/NAS, external hard drives and more. With Parachute, you get peace of mind and full ownership of your data, free from lock-in.

Your Data, Your Way
	•	Back up your entire iCloud Photos library (including Shared Albums) and folders from iCloud Drive.
	•	Preserve originals in full resolution, all adjustment data, and the current edited versions.
	•	Works with USB drives, NAS/SMB/SFTP mounts, Google Drive, S3 Buckets, OneDrive, external hard drives and more

Key Features
	•	Backups can be triggered from the main screen to any of your backup destinations
	•	Automate backups with Shortcuts integration and Schedules
	•	Privacy-first: transfers handled via Apple’s Files extensions — your credentials never touch our app.
	•	Supports full-quality media: Live Photos + videos, RAW images, bursts, edits, and slow motion.

Why It Matters
	•	iCloud sync ≠ backup — deletions, expired storage, or sync errors can mean permanent loss.
	•	Parachute safeguards your digital life from accidents and disasters.
	•	Your files are stored in normal folders you can browse and restore from directly — no special tools needed.

One time purchase. No Lock-In.
	•	One-time purchase unlocks all backup functionality — no recurring fees.
	•	Your data stays in your storage, not ours.
	•	No accounts, no telemetry, no background bloat.


FAQ Highlights

Q: Does Parachute ever delete files from iCloud?
A: Never. It’s strictly read-only.

Q: Can I restore without Parachute?
A: Yes. Backups are just normal folders — copy them back with Finder anytime.

Q: What if a file is corrupted in iCloud?
A: Parachute flags any unexportable items so you know exactly what couldn’t be saved.

Q: Can it back up non-iCloud folders?
A: Yes. Add any folder via the iOS/iPadOS file picker

By downloading Parachute Backup, you agree to Apple's Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and our Privacy Policy (https://parachuteapps.com/privacy).

tr.description:
Solo is the ultimate practice App for mastering fretboard visualization, designed by world renowned guitarists Tom Quayle and David Beebee.

Four powerful fretboard trainers allow you to work intuitively on each aspect of the visualization process; learning note names, memorising interval shapes, outlining chord changes, and practicing scales.

Solo asks you to find intervallic functions against one root note, chord symbol or scale at a time, listens to the notes you play, and doesn’t move on until you’ve correctly found each note by its intervallic function in the specified order.

Practice with Solo and finally learn your note names, master interval shapes, confidently play through chord changes and break out of scale boxes with intervallic functions. Start transforming your playing and confidence on the fretboard today!


NOTE TRAINER
The Note Trainer is perfect for beginner and intermediate players getting to grips with note names on the neck - the foundation of solid fretboard knowledge. 

‣ Solo shows you random root notes to find and listens, waiting for you to get it correct.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Optional practice suggestions offer challenging ways to limit and test yourself.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


INTERVAL TRAINER
The Interval Trainer will help players at all levels work on interval shapes with intervallic functions - the key to unlocking true freedom on the fretboard.

‣ Choose any combination of intervallic functions to practice.
‣ Create custom interval groups or choose the intervals for ANY chord type or scale.
‣ The Interval Trainer will randomise your chosen intervals and ask you to find them against either a fixed or random root note.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams, showing you where all of the interval shapes are across the neck, and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


CHANGES TRAINER
In the Changes Trainer you find intervallic functions, using single notes to outline different chord types or sets of chord changes, a key skill for learning to improvise through chord changes.  

‣ Practice outlining intervallic functions through over 100 common chord progressions and single chord exercises.
‣ 50 intervallic function levels. Go from simple chord tones to complex melodic structures and scales. 
‣ Solo intelligently maps out the correct intervals over each chord and listens for you to play each intervallic function in the specified order.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Transpose the key of any progression or exercise. 
‣ Choose to randomly transpose the progression (or single chord exercise) each time it repeats.
‣ Work on voice leading chord tones through single note lines.


SCALE TRAINER
The Scale Trainer contains a vast array of scales and powerful workout options, allowing you to finally break out of the box and develop a much deeper understanding of how scales are constructed on the fretboard.

‣ Practice finding scales on the fretboard using intervallic functions. 
‣ Over 50+ Scales and modes.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Melodic sequence options let you focus on starting from any chord tone within the scale.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.

EVERY CASE OF CFOP

• Setup moves for each case, and room for your own alias and note.
• Search by name, alias, group or note.

LEARN WITH FLASHCARDS
• Add the cases you are working on to Learning.
• Spaced repetition brings each card back when it is due. Grade it Again, Hard, Good or Easy.
• Practice your hard, new or random cards whenever you like.
• Report: a heat map of your study days, your streak, and what is due in the next 7 days.

PRACTICE UNTIL IT IS AUTOMATIC
• OLL and PLL Recognition Quizzes: name the case from its pattern, against the clock.
• 2-Sided PLL Quiz: name the PLL case from the top and the two sides you see, as on the cube in your hands.
• Random AUF and Random Front Color: meet each case with its top layer turned, and in every color.
• F2L Corner Quiz: name the sticker a corner hides.
• Execution Drill: time a case and beat your best.

GUIDES
• The CFOP method step by step: Overview, Cross, F2L, OLL and PLL. The Cross guide starts from the daisy, for a first cross.
• Example Solve: watch one whole solve on the 3D cube, with every step and case named.
• Notation, with every move shown on a cube.
• Finger Patterns: the triggers and grips behind fast turning.

MADE FOR THE WAY YOU CUBE
• Your color scheme and the way you hold the cube.
• Light, Dark or System appearance.
• English, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese or German, switched right in the app.
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with two-column layouts on wide screens and hardware keyboard shortcuts.

One purchase. No ads, no subscription, no account and no usage analytics.

tr.description:
1990 年，长庄小区一桩离奇母子命案，拉开了跨越五季、长达三十集的庞大中式刑侦悬疑宇宙序幕。

《孙美琪疑案》是一款第一人称 3D 沉浸式硬核探案推理游戏。你将化身刑警刘青春，从第一季《孙美琪》出发，沿着《方婷婷》《王思凤》《王爱国》《杜翠兰》一路深入至第五季终章，孤身踏入上世纪九十年代的老旧居民楼、精神病院、深夜小学、废弃工厂、国际列车、古墓密室与异乡公寓，在极具年代感与压迫感的真实案发现场中搜集隐藏线索，通过“线索关联”层层抽丝剥茧，还原每一桩离奇案件背后令人脊背发凉的真相。

【7.0 五季大合集核心亮点】
• 第 1～5 季、全 30 集一站式收录：完整囊括系列第 1 季至第 5 季全部 30 部独立案件，一集一个独立故事，五季暗线草蛇灰线、环环相扣，老玩家重温与新玩家入坑一步到位。
• 按需分包，轻装上阵：首集内置即玩，其余 29 集支持按需单独下载与随时清理释放空间；支持多集后台排队下载，下载期间可自由畅玩已下载关卡，并内置 4G/5G 移动网络流量确认提醒。
• 硬核 3D 搜证与脑图推理：自由探索阴森写实的 3D 案发现场，不放过每一封信件、每一道划痕与每一件证物；在脑图中将多条线索组合关联，推导全新线索直至锁定核心真相。
• 贴心探案辅助：提供「线索扫描」与脑图「一键关联」辅助功能，卡关时助你快速找回推理思路，既保留硬核解谜成就感，也不再为找不到微小物件而苦恼。
• 独立分集存档管理：30 集进度各自独立保存，支持随时针对单集清空重玩，清空进度不删已下载关卡资源。
• 支持离线畅玩：单集下载完成后即可随时随地离线推理，畅享纯粹的中式悬疑氛围。
• 免费游玩：需要提示时，可选择观看奖励广告获取提示。

跨越五季的迷雾，真相往往藏在最不起眼的角落。准备好手电筒，再次推开那扇门吧。

pt.description:
O Sorapuff é um companheiro de voo carinhoso para quem tem medo de voar. Antes do embarque, ele mostra onde os solavancos são prováveis na sua rota; no ar, explica cada solavanco, offline, com a Sora ao seu lado.

ANTES DE VOAR
• Uma previsão de turbulência para a sua rota, feita no seu iPhone com dados meteorológicos públicos e gratuitos (NOAA)
• Tranquilo, leve ou moderado, trecho por trecho e em palavras simples: "provavelmente tranquilo nas primeiras duas horas"
• Avisos de tempestade (SIGMETs) e relatos recentes de pilotos no caminho
• Um mapa da rota com cada trecho agitado, tempestade e relato de piloto (Pro)
• Lembretes: quando a previsão estiver pronta, para salvá-la antes do Modo Avião e no embarque

NO AR, NO MODO AVIÃO
• Um rastreador de voo bem grande: onde você está, quanto falta e o que vem depois
• Um medidor de solavancos tranquilo que mede cada solavanco e conta o quanto ele foi pequeno de verdade. A asa é feita para 2,5 g
• Dicas da Sora para cada fase, do taxiamento ao pouso
• Um aviso 10 minutos antes de um trecho agitado, para nada te pegar de surpresa

QUANDO PARECER DEMAIS
• Um toque em Calma: respire com a Sora, sinta cada respiração como uma vibração suave e lenta, e volte ao presente passo a passo
• Música calma opcional, criada ao vivo no seu iPhone
• Funciona na Tela de Início, com a Siri, Atalhos, o botão de Ação e a Central de Controle

DEPOIS DO POUSO
• Seu relatório de solavancos: cada solavanco explicado em palavras, e uma imagem fofa para compartilhar ("Eu voei!")
• Colecione Cartas do céu a cada momento de coragem e vista a Sora com roupinhas novas

QUEM VOA AJUDANDO QUEM VOA
• Depois do pouso, envie os solavancos daquele voo com um toque: anônimo, só dois códigos de aeroporto, a hora e os solavancos
• Cada voo compartilhado compara a previsão com os solavancos reais e ajuda a melhorá-la para o próximo passageiro nervoso

ENCONTRE SEUS VOOS, COM PRIVACIDADE
• Cole o e-mail da reserva, abra o PDF ou escaneie o cartão de embarque
• Ou deixe o Sorapuff procurar reservas no seu calendário ou, se você quiser, no seu e-mail em modo somente leitura, no seu iPhone

PRIVADO DESDE A CONCEPÇÃO
• Sem conta, sem anúncios, sem rastreamento, sem análises
• Seus voos ficam no seu iPhone

PAGUE UMA VEZ
O Sorapuff é grátis para baixar, com o medidor de solavancos, o rastreador, Calma, a respiração e sua primeira previsão de rota. O Sorapuff Pro é uma compra única, sem assinatura: previsões ilimitadas até 3 dias antes, o mapa da rota, todas as Cartas do céu e roupinhas, todos os ambientes musicais, o widget e a Atividade ao Vivo. Compartilhamento Familiar incluído.

O Sorapuff oferece informação e ferramentas para acalmar. Não é aconselhamento médico: siga sempre as orientações da tripulação.

pt.description:
O Comic Weather é um app do tempo para iPhone que transforma a previsão numa página de HQ. O céu sobre você é pintado como o quadrinho de abertura, um narrador resume o dia numa caixa amarela, e as próximas horas e dias vêm nos quadrinhos abaixo.

Sob o nanquim, uma previsão de verdade do Apple Weather: da chuva da próxima hora a 10 dias.

QUATRO ESTILOS DE HQ
• Quatro Cores: o visual das bancas. Pontos Ben-Day, cores primárias e nanquim carregado.
• Flor de Chiclete: pop pastel. Rosa-chiclete, menta e lilás, flores e brilhos.
• Mangá Megacidade: nanquim denso sobre uma metrópole gigante.
• Cidade da Meia-Noite: noir gótico. Páginas quase negras, luz âmbar de lampião, torres na chuva.
O estilo reimprime o app inteiro: ícones, widgets e ícone do app.

192 CENAS PINTADAS
Doze tipos de tempo, ao amanhecer, de dia, ao entardecer e à noite, nos quatro estilos. Toda cena se mexe: a chuva desaba, a neblina chega, os lampiões piscam, o raio estala.

CHUVA CONTRA O RELÓGIO
Onde o Apple Weather tem dados minuto a minuto, um quadrinho mostra a próxima hora: “Chuva começa em 12 min.” Toque em “Acompanhar na Tela Bloqueada” e a contagem regressiva vai para lá e para a Dynamic Island, ou deixe-a começar sozinha no seu local principal.

PREVISÃO DO PÔR DO SOL
Céu em chamas ou fiasco? Um quadrinho novo dá ao próximo pôr do sol uma nota de 0 a 100, de Fiasco a Épico, com o horário do pôr do sol e quando começa a hora dourada e termina a azul. Ele lê as nuvens baixas, médias e altas e diz o porquê: “Nuvens altas para pegar a cor.” Uma previsão, não uma promessa.

CADA ESTILO TEM SUA VOZ
Um narrador por estilo, para narrações e notificações. Troque quando quiser:
• Quatro Cores, Dramático: “A neblina engole a cidade por inteiro.”
• Flor de Chiclete, Animado: “Neblina! A cidade está brincando de esconde-esconde.”
• Mangá Megacidade, Empolgado: “Nevoeiro. O mapa ainda não carregou.”
• Cidade da Meia-Noite, Seco: “Neblina. O mundo está em baixa resolução.”

A PREVISÃO, QUADRINHO A QUADRINHO
• Condições atuais, sensação térmica, máxima e mínima de hoje
• Neste momento: vento e rajadas, umidade, UV, pressão, visibilidade, nascer e pôr do sol
• 24 horas, hora a hora, com chance de chuva
• 10 dias: toque num dia para ver total de chuva, vento, UV, sol e lua
• Salve locais e deslize entre eles
• Suas unidades: °C ou °F, e vento até em nós ou Beaufort

NOTIFICAÇÕES SÓ QUANDO A PREVISÃO PEDE
• Boletim matinal na hora que você escolher
• Alertas de chuva antes de começar e de parar
• Dicas à noite: “Amanhã vai fazer sol — faça planos”
• Alertas de tempo severo e aviso de calor ou geada para amanhã
• Alertas de pôr do sol cerca de 1 h antes, se tiver cara de Vibrante ou Épico
O iPhone calcula tudo com a previsão que já tem. Ative ou desative cada tipo.

WIDGETS, SIRI E CENTRAL DE CONTROLE
• Página de HQ (grande), Tirinha (médio) e Quadrinho (pequeno)
• Ícone do Tempo para a Tela Bloqueada
• Pergunte à Siri “Vai chover, Comic Weather?” ou use os Atalhos
• Tempo Agora: a temperatura na Central de Controle

FALA O SEU IDIOMA
Tudo no app fala 26 idiomas, de Português a हिन्दी e 日本語.

PRIVACIDADE DE FÁBRICA
Sem conta. Sem rastreamento. Sem análise de dados. Sua localização, arredondada para cerca de 100 metros, vai direto ao serviço meteorológico. Não existe servidor do Comic Weather.

FEITO PARA VOICEOVER E TEXTO GRANDE
O VoiceOver lê cada quadrinho, e “Ler sem piadas” vai direto ao ponto. O texto aumenta até os maiores tamanhos de acessibilidade.

GRÁTIS PARA TESTAR, PAGUE UMA VEZ PELO FULL
Grátis: Quatro Cores, a previsão de 10 dias, os alertas de chuva e um widget pequeno. Teste tudo grátis por 7 dias e depois desbloqueie o Full uma única vez: todos os estilos e narradores, a Previsão do pôr do sol, todos os widgets, a contagem regressiva da chuva. Sem assinatura, sem anúncios. Já comprou? Tudo continua seu.

Dados do Apple Weather, com o MET Norway como reserva. Apple Weather é uma marca comercial da Apple Inc.

Dúvidas ou ideias: support@comicweather.app

pt.releaseNotes:
O ScreenCommand 3.0 traz para a TV um menu de clique com o botão direito e uma mão sobre os links, um histórico de navegação e cliques que caem onde você mira. No iOS 27, o teclado volta a funcionar.

Novidades na TV
• Um clique com o botão direito (um toque com dois dedos no trackpad ou o botão direito do mouse) abre um menu na TV: abrir um link em uma nova aba, copiar um link ou o endereço de uma imagem, copiar o texto selecionado, colar, Voltar, Avançar e Recarregar.
• O cursor vira uma mão sobre links e botões (Ajustes › Trackpad e Cursor › Mão que aponta). A barra de endereço da TV tem um botão de tela cheia, que pode ser desativado em Ajustes › Monitor Externo › Botão de Tela Cheia na TV.
• O endereço que você edita no iPad ou iPhone aparece na TV como em um campo de texto: a seleção destacada, ou um cursor piscando. Com o mouse na TV, clique para colocar o cursor ali, arraste para selecionar e clique duas vezes para selecionar uma palavra.
• O escudo na barra de endereço da TV: desative o bloqueador de pop-ups para o site na tela quando uma página não funcionar bem, ou para todos os sites, ative ou desative "Bloquear Todos os Pop-ups" e veja quantos pop-ups foram barrados na página. O escudo na barra de endereço do iPad ou do iPhone tem os mesmos botões.
• − e + na barra de endereço da TV mostram o tamanho da página, com Redefinir. Ao editar um endereço, uma seta o abre; em páginas de login, uma chave abre suas senhas salvas.

Novidades no iPad e no iPhone
• Histórico: as páginas que você abre na TV, por dia e com busca, no relógio ao lado de Favoritos no iPad ou iPhone. O relógio ao lado da estrela na TV mostra as mais recentes. Abra uma de novo, deslize para apagá-la ou limpe a última hora, as últimas 24 horas, 7 dias, 4 semanas ou tudo.
• Ajustes › Privacidade: limpe o histórico, ou limpe os cookies e os dados de sites para sair dos sites e começar do zero.
• Ajustes › Favoritos › Importar do Safari: os favoritos do Safari chegam aos Favoritos com as pastas, a partir da exportação do próprio Safari no iPad ou iPhone, ou de um arquivo de favoritos de um Mac, do Chrome ou do Firefox.
• Ajustes › Modo Cinema › Em qualquer página: com teclado e mouse na TV, o iPad ou iPhone escurece após alguns segundos sem toque, em qualquer página, não só durante vídeos. Com o brilho em 0%, a tela fica totalmente preta. Toque nela para trazê-la de volta.
• No iPhone, a barra de volume ajusta o volume do próprio iPhone, que pelo AirPlay é o volume da TV.

Mais fluido
• Os cliques caem onde você mira em qualquer zoom de página, no iPhone também, e os menus dos players de vídeo, como legendas e qualidade, abrem com um clique e ficam abertos.
• Rolar uma página mais larga que a TV não a desloca mais para o lado, então o clique cai onde você mira.
• Com a barra de endereço aberta, um clique num campo na TV passa o teclado para esse campo, então o que você digita vai para onde você faz login, não para o endereço.

Correções
• No iOS 27, o teclado volta a aparecer quando você toca em um campo na TV ou no botão do teclado, e "Como Usar o ScreenCommand" volta a mostrar o tutorial.
• No YouTube, pausar ou retomar um vídeo em tela cheia pelo iPad ou iPhone não confunde mais o botão de tela cheia: ele mostra "Sair da Tela Cheia", e um toque basta para sair.
• Com um mouse, um clique conta uma vez (um vídeo pausa, os menus Aa e do escudo ficam abertos), a roda mantém a página centralizada sem faixas pretas e o mouse fica na TV até você passá-lo para o iPad.
• Os vídeos do Vimeo voltam a tocar na TV: o iPad ou o iPhone não abre mais "Verificar aqui" em páginas do Vimeo que nunca pediram isso.

Dúvidas ou sugestões? support@screencommand.app
pt.description:
Um navegador desktop completo na sua TV ou monitor, com o iPad ou iPhone como trackpad e teclado. Netflix, Prime Video e outros serviços de streaming rodam por cabo. Sem computador. Pague uma vez, sem assinatura.
EXIGE UM MONITOR EXTERNO OU TV. O navegador do próprio ScreenCommand ocupa a TV em resolução total, sem faixas pretas. Não é uma cópia da sua tela, e outros apps não rodam na TV. Sem tela, o app abre a tela "Conectar Monitor Externo"; não há navegação no dispositivo.

CABO: iPad USB-C, ou iPhone 15+ e iPhone Duo, exceto iPhone 16e, 17e e Air, com adaptador USB-C para HDMI ou DisplayPort. O cabo de carregamento da caixa não transmite vídeo.

AIRPLAY: qualquer iPad ou iPhone, com um aparelho Apple TV (não o app) no seu Wi-Fi. Inicie o Espelhamento de Tela com o ScreenCommand aberto; a TV mostra só o navegador. Sites, YouTube e vídeos da web rodam, com leve atraso no cursor. Serviços de streaming exigem cabo.

Funciona em qualquer iPad USB-C, mesmo sem chip M, onde o iPadOS não oferece tela estendida. 8 estilos de cursor, até 12 abas que continuam abertas, duas páginas lado a lado, YouTube em até 4K, legendas, downloads e um histórico que você pode apagar. Também funciona com teclado físico e, no iPad, com mouse.

TELA EXTERNA SEM COMPLICAÇÃO
• Navegação web completa no monitor externo
• Detecção automática: é só conectar e usar
• Otimizado para telas 1080p, 4K e ultrawide

CURSOR E CONTROLES AVANÇADOS
• Oito estilos de cursor incríveis: Default, Cyberpunk Neon, Elegant Glass, Liquid Crystal, Gaming Pro, Luxury Gold, Aurora Borealis e Minimal Dark
• Navegação suave no trackpad, com gestos
• Mouse ou trackpad Bluetooth ou USB no iPad
• Rolagem natural com dois dedos
• Clique, clique duplo e clique direito precisos

TECLADO INTELIGENTE
• Teclado completo para formulários e buscas
• Teclado físico com atalhos como ⌘L, ⌘T e ⌘R
• Barra de endereço: digite um site ou uma busca

CONTROLES DE MÍDIA
• Um toque para dar play ou pausar

• Ajuste o volume com o controle na tela
• Avance e volte pela barra de progresso
• Modo Cinema (Cinema Mode) para assistir sem distrações

NAVEGAÇÃO PODEROSA
• Até 4 janelas de navegador com 12 abas cada, salvas entre as sessões
• Duas janelas lado a lado
• Preenchimento automático de senhas
• Modo desktop para compatibilidade total com sites
• "O Que Funciona Aqui" explica a sua conexão
• Bloqueador de pop-ups com ajuste por site

PERSONALIZAÇÃO
• Tamanho do cursor ajustável (0,2x a 5,0x)
• Velocidade do mouse para precisão ou rapidez (0,5x a 5,0x)
• Defina a URL da página inicial
• Abra o navegador automaticamente ao conectar o monitor

PRIVACIDADE EM PRIMEIRO LUGAR
• Nenhuma coleta de dados nem rastreamento

pt.description:
Grounds Up é um jogo de tycoon de negócios para iPhone, para um jogador. Vai abrir o seu primeiro café numa rua movimentada. Em cada semana, define preços, paga à sua equipa, escolhe o seu café e vê os resultados. Depois a empresa cresce muito além do café: mais cafés em mais cidades, hotéis, um laboratório de IA e um fundo só seu.

O tempo só avança quando toca na data, uma semana de cada vez. Não há temporizador nem fim de jogo. Tudo no jogo é inventado: as empresas, as pessoas, os bancos e o dinheiro. É um jogo, não um serviço financeiro, e nada nele é aconselhamento financeiro.

UM GRUPO QUE NÃO PARA DE CRESCER
• Abra cafés em oito cidades: Osaka, Tóquio, Nova Iorque, Chicago, Londres, Paris, Berlim e São Paulo.
• Escolha o aspeto, as máquinas, a ementa e os preços de cada café, e contrate gestores para os dirigirem.
• Abra hotéis. Escolha a categoria, os quartos e as tarifas, e leia as opiniões dos hóspedes.
• Crie um laboratório de IA e faça-o crescer com investigação, produtos e rondas de financiamento.
• Dirija um fundo com investidores externos e um historial que define o tamanho do seguinte.
• Arrende escritórios, compre imóveis e compre e dê nome a monumentos.

PARTICIPAÇÕES, CONSELHOS E VOTAÇÕES
• Compre ações de empresas cotadas e apoie startups nas suas rondas de financiamento.
• Construa uma participação suficiente para um lugar no conselho, depois mais lugares e, por fim, a presidência.
• Participe nas reuniões do conselho. Leia os factos, pondere as opções e vote, ou deixe que os seus lugares votem por si.
• Conquiste o controlo de uma empresa e integre-a no seu grupo.

RIVAIS E RECORDES
• 300 magnatas rivais fazem crescer as suas fortunas enquanto constrói a sua.
• Suba na lista dos mais ricos e persiga recordes, desde o seu primeiro mil milhões.
• Jogue em Descontraído, Normal, Difícil ou Tycoon, com até cinco empresas rivais.

PAGUE UMA VEZ, NADA MAIS PARA COMPRAR
• Um único pagamento na App Store.
• Sem anúncios. Sem compras na aplicação. Sem subscrição.
• Funciona offline. O jogo nunca precisa de internet.
• Sem conta. Sem rastreio. Guarde até dez jogos no seu iPhone.

Todas as empresas, pessoas e o dinheiro do jogo são inventados. Nada aqui é aconselhamento financeiro.

pt.description:
Pay-per-book: Your first notebook with unlimited pages is included with your initial purchase, and you can add up to four more books for a one-time fee of $1.99 each. All features included, forever. No subscriptions, ever. That is a promise. 

TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook into the digital world, with smart tools to find your notes whenever you need them and endless ways to make it yours. All topped off with stunning cover art options made by real humans and endless ways to personalise your notebook.

No account required. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Opens to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. To enter swipe the book cover or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget. 

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Link Notes, add photos, PDFs, timestamps, checklists, titles, bullet points and more to your notes. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way around.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout. 

- Make it yours! Pick lined, grid, blank or dotted paper and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts, choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts or even upload your own. And if that’s not enough, turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour for all pages or just one specific page, and go wild. Ooh, and wait until you’ve seen our gorgeous Dark Mode.

- Choose from beautiful cover artworks from our own TypeDraw collection or explore premium art from illustrators like Gabor Estefan and make your notebook something truly satisfying to look at every time you open it. Take that, generative AI!

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too, and you can reorder them with a simple drag and drop.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

pt.description:
NaviBeat brings your own music library to every Apple device you own: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch, plus CarPlay, as a single Universal Purchase. Pay once.

No subscriptions. No ads. No tracking. No NaviBeat cloud. Your music stays on your own server, exactly where you put it. NaviBeat just plays it, beautifully.

ABOUT NAVIDROME

NaviBeat is a client for Navidrome, the free and open-source self-hosted music server. Run Navidrome on a NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS or any machine you control, and NaviBeat streams your collection to every Apple device. Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic and any OpenSubsonic server work too.

ON iPHONE & iPAD
- Browse artists, albums, playlists and genres
- Voice and text search with live results
- Now Playing with synced lyrics
- Background audio, Control Center, AirPlay, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets
- Offline: keep a song, an album, a playlist or a whole artist on the device
- Listening Stats: a 24-hour clock, a weekday heatmap, your top artists and songs
- Smart Playlists you write yourself, from rating, genre, year, play count and more, kept current and synced across your devices
- Start on one device and carry on with another. The device you left pauses itself

IN THE CAR

- Full CarPlay support, included in the same purchase
- Your library, playlists, downloads and Now Playing on the car screen
- Voice search that resolves the play command against your own library, not a streaming catalogue, in every language the app ships

ON MAC

- A real Mac app, not a phone app in a window
- A Mini Player that pins over any window
- Keyboard shortcuts, multi-window and directory browsing, desktop widgets
- NaviSyncRock: sync your library to a Rockbox player. Your server does the transcoding, art is re-encoded so it renders, and plays sync back. A separate one-time in-app unlock.

ON APPLE TV

- Cinema-scale artwork and discovery shelves
- Recently Played, Most Played, Rediscover, On This Day, Because You Listened To
- Voice search via the Siri Remote
- Full-screen Now Playing with synced lyrics

ON APPLE WATCH

- Now Playing complications on any watch face
- Music stored on the watch and played from it, so you can run without your iPhone
- Downloads pulled straight from your server over Wi-Fi

AUDIO

- Selectable high-fidelity playback engine
- 10-band equalizer with presets
- ReplayGain volume normalisation, per track or per album
- Gapless playback
- Streaming quality set separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, in Opus, AAC and MP3 tiers, or send the original file untouched
- Internet radio

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY

- Multi-library Navidrome support: All Libraries, a single library, or any subset, filtered on the server
- Star ratings synced to your server
- Classical music: automatic work and movement grouping
- Optional Last.fm and ListenBrainz integration. Scrobbles route through your own server, never directly from the app.
- Server Health diagnostics: server type, version, OpenSubsonic extensions, scan status

REACHING YOUR SERVER

Built for a locked-down homelab. Custom HTTP headers for Cloudflare Access and Authelia, mTLS client certificates, and access over Tailscale all work, on every platform, with no third-party relay in between.

MULTIPLE LANGUAGES

The app comes in multiple languages, with an in-app language picker on every platform.

REQUIREMENTS

NaviBeat requires a running Navidrome server (v0.50 or later, free and open source) accessible from your Apple device. Self-host it on a home NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS, or any machine you control. See navibeat.app for setup.

NaviBeat is a third-party client, not affiliated with the Navidrome project.

PRIVACY

NaviBeat collects zero data. There is no NaviBeat backend, no analytics, no telemetry and no third-party SDKs. Your credentials live in your device's Keychain. Your listening history stays on device. See navibeat.app/privacy.

Defeat slimes, gather resources, and grow even stronger!

This is an incremental action game where your attack power and firepower increase endlessly with every battle. Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep!

■ Visible Progress with Every Fight
Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons.
Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards.

■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices
Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities.
The skills you upgrade first will change both your combat style and progression speed. Build your skill tree around your own strategy and complete a powerful build.

■ Explosive Firepower with Cards and Relics
Combine cards and relics obtained in battle to unlock new abilities and progression bonuses.
Call down lightning, summon boomerangs that ricochet off walls, and dominate the battlefield with powerful special weapons. As your build comes together, battles become even flashier and more powerful.

■ Mercenaries That Support Your Progress and Combat
Unique mercenaries from across dimensions track and attack enemies in their own ways.
Freeze enemies, call down meteors, and use wide-area mercenary skills. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies.

■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger
Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower.
Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits.

■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression
Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems.
Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies.

■ The Secret of No More Slimes!!
The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army.
Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge?

Game Features
- Incremental progression that makes you stronger with every battle
- Increased firepower through resource gathering and repeated upgrades
- A skill tree that changes based on your choices
- Build combinations using cards and relics
- Unique interdimensional mercenaries
- A wide variety of abilities, including lightning, freezing, meteors, and boomerangs

Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
	Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.

Features:

- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

In this spectacular game of colossal fun, reveal numbers one-by-one and close a corresponding square on one of your cards.

pt.description:
BimmerLink é a conexão direta com seu BMW, MINI ou Toyota Supra. Leia e apague códigos de falha, monitore dados dos sensores em tempo real e use funções de manutenção diretamente pelo seu celular.

É necessário um adaptador OBD compatível ou um cabo apropriado. A disponibilidade dos recursos depende do veículo e de seus equipamentos.

LER E APAGAR CÓDIGOS DE FALHA
Leia e apague códigos de falha de diagnóstico de todas as unidades de controle do veículo.

DADOS DOS SENSORES EM TEMPO REAL
Monitore em tempo real valores como temperatura do óleo e pressão do turbo. Crie um painel personalizado para manter sempre à vista os dados mais importantes para você.

REGISTRO DE DADOS
Registre os valores dos sensores em arquivos CSV para uma análise detalhada.

FUNÇÕES DAS UNIDADES DE CONTROLE
Acesse dados em tempo real e funções de diagnóstico de unidades de controle individuais do veículo.

CONTROLE DA VÁLVULA DO ESCAPAMENTO
Escolha se a válvula do escapamento do veículo deve permanecer aberta ou fechada. Requer uma válvula do escapamento instalada de fábrica.

ACTIVE SOUND DESIGN
Silencie o som artificial do motor gerado pelo Active Sound Design (ASD). Requer ASD instalado de fábrica.

SOUND TUNING
Desative os estouros no escapamento em veículos equipados com o motor S55 (M2 Competition, M3 e M4).

REGENERAÇÃO DO DPF
Verifique o estado do filtro de partículas diesel e inicie uma regeneração quando necessário. Disponível em veículos a diesel compatíveis equipados com DPF.

ADD-ON DO CARPLAY
Use o CarPlay para visualizar em tempo real os dados dos sensores das unidades de controle do motor e controlar a válvula do escapamento e o Active Sound Design diretamente pela tela do veículo. É necessária uma compra adicional no app.

REGISTRO DA BATERIA
Registre uma nova bateria após a substituição diretamente pelo app.

MODO DE SERVIÇO DO FREIO DE ESTACIONAMENTO
Ative o modo de serviço do freio de estacionamento eletromecânico do veículo.

REDEFINIÇÃO DE SERVIÇO
Redefina os indicadores de manutenção após concluir serviços como troca do óleo do motor ou substituição das pastilhas de freio.

REDEFINIR BLOQUEIOS DE CURTO-CIRCUITO
Redefina os bloqueios de curto-circuito na unidade de controle de iluminação.

VALORES DE ADAPTAÇÃO DA TRANSMISSÃO
Visualize os valores de adaptação da transmissão automática ZF 8HP do veículo.

ACESSÓRIOS NECESSÁRIOS
O BimmerLink requer um adaptador OBD Bluetooth ou Wi-Fi compatível ou um cabo apropriado. Acesse bimmerlink.app para obter informações sobre acessórios e veículos compatíveis.

pt.description:
Wipr blocks ads, popups, trackers, cookie warnings, and other nasty things that make the web slow and ugly.

Websites in Safari will look clean, load fast, and stop invisibly tracking you. You’ll notice significant improvements to your battery life and data usage. Setup is a snap. Apple featured Wipr in “The Best Safari Extensions”.

The Filtr add-on extends Wipr’s blocking to all apps on your devices. It acts at the network level, but unlike a VPN, it can access none of your data, and can be used in conjunction with VPNs, iCloud Private Relay, and custom DNS.

Wipr’s blocklist is updated twice a week automatically, and has enhanced versions for the following languages: Bosnian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Montenegrin, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese.

pt.description:
Jogue os capítulos 1 a 10 grátis. Uma única compra libera todos os 40 capítulos.

No arsenal do antigo reino de Veyrholm, armas famintas dormiam. Elas devoraram as almas do rei e do povo, até que os Nove Guardiões as acorrentaram e selaram. O jogo começa no dia em que o primeiro selo se rompe.

Você é uma dessas armas. Os ataques são automáticos: mova-se com o joystick à esquerda e use a sua habilidade de movimento com o botão à direita. Cada vez que você corta um inimigo, a sua Fome enche um pouco. Quando a Fome acaba, a arma dorme e a partida termina. Use as Almas juntadas na partida para gravar Lascas na Anatomia da Arma, e na próxima partida você acorda mais forte na mesma medida.

A cada nível você escolhe 1 entre 3 cartas de maldição. Se levar uma carta de ataque ao máximo tendo a carta de suporte que forma par com ela, ela evolui. As relíquias que os Elites derrubam mudam as regras da partida em vez dos seus atributos.

- 6 armas: Espada Maldita, Machado Maldito, Arco Maldito, Cajado Maldito, Lâminas Gêmeas Malditas e Lança Amaldiçoada. Cada uma tem seu ataque básico e sua habilidade de movimento (Avanço, Salto, Rolamento, Lampejo, Ventania), e derrotar pela primeira vez o Chefão de certos capítulos desperta novas armas.
- 8 áreas e 40 capítulos. São quatro dificuldades (Novato, Fácil, Normal e Difícil), e, no jogo completo, vencer o capítulo 5 abre o Modo Infinito.
- Quatro capítulos da primeira área têm cada um a sua cara: um ossário à luz de velas, uma cripta de esgoto por onde corre água, um santuário de ossos violeta e uma capela subterrânea iluminada pela lua e por vitrais.
- 8 Guardiões, 8 capitães de Elite e 8 Subchefes mais fortes lutam cada um com técnicas próprias. Todo ataque é avisado antes.
- 19 cartas de ataque, 23 cartas de suporte, 22 evoluções, 21 relíquias e 7 Familiares.
- A Anatomia da Arma é uma espada em pé com quatro ramos e 159 Lascas.
- A Forja tem 5 espaços de Peças, e afiar com Pedras de Afiar nunca falha e vai até +20. Em +5, +10, +15 e +20 o efeito sobe mais uma vez.
- Visual: personalize as 7 partes de cada arma, com 6.434 visuais entre as 6 armas. Há 90 conjuntos para equipar de uma vez, incluindo os das edições Joseon, Natal, Biscoitos, Lanchonete e Banho público. Eles abrem conforme você vence capítulos e derrota inimigos, e nada é comprado com dinheiro.
- Depois do final, abrem-se 10 Níveis de Maldição. Também há recordes por arma e a Recompensa do dia.
- Durante a partida também aparecem um Espectro do tesouro que foge, um Altar amaldiçoado de onde saem Elites e um Mímico que se passa por baú.
- Os capítulos 1 a 10 (o ossuário e o mosteiro, com a Espada e o Machado) são grátis. Uma única compra de "Liberar jogo completo" abre os 40 capítulos, as 6 armas, o final e os Níveis de Maldição, mantendo seu progresso. Se você já comprou o jogo, tudo continua liberado. Sem anúncios e sem gacha. O progresso fica salvo no aparelho.
- Disponível em coreano, inglês, chinês simplificado, chinês tradicional, russo, português do Brasil, espanhol e alemão.

Do mesmo desenvolvedor: Sasinpae, um roguelike de cartas em que você enfrenta dokkaebis dos contos populares coreanos.

pt.description:
Toastie turns your iPhone into a toaster. Work through the orders on the menu, let the chef surprise you, or make your own sandwich from everything in the kitchen.

Make a grilled cheese sandwich from scratch: butter the bread, lay on the cheese and fillings, and put it in the toaster. Close the lid and it starts toasting in real time. Open it too early and the cheese hasn't melted; leave it too long and it burns. Take it out at the right moment and you get a perfect toastie.

HOW IT WORKS
• Butter the bread with your finger: cover the slice, on the right side.
• Drag the cheese and fillings onto the bread and spread them out.
• Hurry: customers are waiting. You have 20 seconds to build each order.
• Press GRILL, close the lid, and wait for the sizzle.
• Open it to check, or trust your timing, then serve.
• Every sandwich gets a score card: recipe, plating, toasting and prep time. Five stars turn it gold.
• Four stars unlock the next recipe.

NEW: CHEF'S CHOICE
A surprise order from 100 new recipes, dealt at random. Make it, shuffle for another, and see how long a streak you can keep going.

NEW: TOAST-OFF
Challenge a friend face to face, on one iPad or an opened iPhone Duo. You both get the same orders: build, grill and serve. After one, three, five or seven rounds, the most stars wins.

NEW: RELAXED MODE
Like to take your time? Switch on Relaxed mode in Settings and play every order without the clock.

MAKE YOUR OWN
No ticket, no clock. Pick a loaf and put on whatever you like, from every ingredient in the kitchen. Grill it, and the cook tells you what worked and what to change. Give your sandwich a name and save it: your saved toasties now sync with iCloud across your devices. Under CUSTOMIZE you pick the plate, the table and the wall, from eight of each.

THE CAFÉ MENU, NOW 25 ORDERS
Ten new orders join the fifteen from cafés around the world. Clear all 25 for awards of their own.

LANDSCAPE ON IPHONE
On iPhone, orders play in landscape, with more room to build and grill. Prefer portrait? Switch back any time in Settings.

THE MENUS
Work through the House Menu, from a Classic Grilled Cheese and Cheese & Tomato to Brie & Cranberry, Mushroom & Taleggio and The Works. Then explore the Café Menu, with a Caprese, a Chicken Pesto Panini, a Kimchi Tuna Melt and a Guacamole Melt. All on white sandwich loaf, sourdough, brioche or ciabatta.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Toastie plays on any iPhone and iPad. On iPhone Duo, the phone itself becomes the toaster: fold it shut to close the lid, and open it to see how your sandwich is doing. Opened, it plays Toast-Off too.

NOW IN SEVEN LANGUAGES
English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

ALSO
• Share a picture of your toastie.
• Your progress syncs with iCloud across your devices.
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements.
• No ads, no in-app purchases. Pay once.

The world's most expensive toaster.

A new Start Backup action replaces Start Photo Backup and Start File Backup, joined by actions to stop a backup and ask how it is going. Your existing shortcuts keep working.
 ALSO IN THIS UPDATE
• The Live Activity has been redesigned.
• Much improved error reporting.
• New progress sounds. You can turn them off in Settings.
• Many other small improvements and bug fixes.
• Version 2.0.1: Minor fixes and new screenshots.

Version 2.0.2
• New: Option to keep deleted items forever.
• Fixed a crash shortly after starting a backup.
• More reliable mirroring, free space and progress for network share Destinations.

Version 2.0.3
• Drive or network share not connected? Parachute Backup now tells you which destination to connect, in the app, on the Lock Screen and in a notification. The backup continues on its own once it is back.
• Backups started from Shortcuts now wait for a network share that takes a while to reconnect, instead of stopping.
• When your cloud storage asks you to sign in again, the backup stops right away instead of waiting for hours. Sign in from the main screen and the backup runs again.
• The Keep Items duration for mirrored Files backups no longer snaps back to 90 Days.
• Photos Settings on iPhone now shows your changes right away.
• The Destination row shows drive or share and folder, like "NAS ▸ Backups".
• Fixed random characters in front of some network share names.

Version 2.0.4
• When a download from iCloud stalls, a countdown now shows how long Parachute Backup waits for it.
• Stop now ends a backup right away, also while it waits for a download.
• Unchanged items in OneDrive folders with more than 200 items are no longer uploaded again on every backup.
• Items with "%20" in their name now copy to S3 instead of failing with a permission error.
• Network shares: Start Backup in Shortcuts no longer reports an error while the backup waits for the share, and you get one notification instead of two when the wait runs out.
• A document that a network share refused to replace is no longer reported as a Photos library that is not included.

Version 2.0.5
• Fixes a blank screen on iPadOS 27.3 beta.
• Some NAS models do not provide a folder listing to iPhone and iPad. Parachute Backup now detects that situation, keeps backing up, and tells you why deletions cannot be mirrored.
• Before you add a folder on a NAS as a Destination, Parachute Backup now checks it for known problems and tells you about them.
• When a photo or video fails to copy, you now see whether it comes from the Photo Library or from a shared album, and which album.
• A backup that lasts less than a second no longer shows 0 s.
pt.description:
Parachute is your backup companion for iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive. It backs up your memories — photos, videos, and documents — to storage you control, whether that’s an external drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 Buckets, network drives/NAS, external hard drives and more. With Parachute, you get peace of mind and full ownership of your data, free from lock-in.

Your Data, Your Way
	•	Back up your entire iCloud Photos library (including Shared Albums) and folders from iCloud Drive.
	•	Preserve originals in full resolution, all adjustment data, and the current edited versions.
	•	Works with USB drives, NAS/SMB/SFTP mounts, Google Drive, S3 Buckets, OneDrive, external hard drives and more

Key Features
	•	Backups can be triggered from the main screen to any of your backup destinations
	•	Automate backups with Shortcuts integration and Schedules
	•	Privacy-first: transfers handled via Apple’s Files extensions — your credentials never touch our app.
	•	Supports full-quality media: Live Photos + videos, RAW images, bursts, edits, and slow motion.

Why It Matters
	•	iCloud sync ≠ backup — deletions, expired storage, or sync errors can mean permanent loss.
	•	Parachute safeguards your digital life from accidents and disasters.
	•	Your files are stored in normal folders you can browse and restore from directly — no special tools needed.

One time purchase. No Lock-In.
	•	One-time purchase unlocks all backup functionality — no recurring fees.
	•	Your data stays in your storage, not ours.
	•	No accounts, no telemetry, no background bloat.


FAQ Highlights

Q: Does Parachute ever delete files from iCloud?
A: Never. It’s strictly read-only.

Q: Can I restore without Parachute?
A: Yes. Backups are just normal folders — copy them back with Finder anytime.

Q: What if a file is corrupted in iCloud?
A: Parachute flags any unexportable items so you know exactly what couldn’t be saved.

Q: Can it back up non-iCloud folders?
A: Yes. Add any folder via the iOS/iPadOS file picker

By downloading Parachute Backup, you agree to Apple's Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and our Privacy Policy (https://parachuteapps.com/privacy).
